                task.delay(0.24, function()
                    if alive and token == transition and not state.enabled then controls.Visible = false end
                end)
            end
        end
        state.setEnabled = setEnabled
        connect(toggle.Activated, function()
            if config.command then QuickPlus.runCommand(state) else setEnabled(not state.enabled) end
        end)

        if state.hasSlider then
            local function slide(x)
                if not state.enabled or track.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then return end
                local ratio = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
                setValue(state.minimum + ratio * (state.maximum - state.minimum), true)
            end
            connect(entry.FocusLost, function()
                setValue(entry.Text, true)
                entryBorder.Color = colors.Track
            end)
            connect(entry.Focused, function() entryBorder.Color = config.accent end)
            connect(slider.InputBegan, function(input)
                if not state.enabled or not page.Visible then return end
                local kind = input.UserInputType
                if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
                stopDragging()
                wasScrolling = page.ScrollingEnabled
                page.ScrollingEnabled = false
                drag = { state = state, input = input, slide = slide }
                slide(input.Position.X)
            end)
        end
        table.insert(featureCards, { animation = spin, cancel = stopTweens })
        repaint()
    end

    -- Touch-friendly vertical controls stay accessible after the main UI is minimised.
    local moveHud = newFrame(MainGui, "QuickVerticalControls", UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 99),
        UDim2.new(1, -126, 1, -156), Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 34))
    moveHud.ZIndex = 50
    moveHud.Visible = false

        UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 5), 9, colors.Cyan, true).TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    local heldPointers = {}
    local function verticalButton(title, x, direction)
        local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
        button.Text = title
        button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        button.TextSize = 11
        button.TextColor3 = colors.White
        button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 0, 36)
        button.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 29)
        button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 43, 70)
        button.BorderSizePixel = 0
        button.Parent = moveHud
        RedUI.Corner(button, 8)
        connect(button.InputBegan, function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                verticalHeld[direction] = true
                heldPointers[direction] = input
            end
        end)
    end

    verticalButton("DOWN", 60, "down")

        UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 72), 8, colors.Muted, true).TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    updateMovementHud = function()
        local active = false
        for _, key in ipairs(movementGroup) do
            if byKey[key] and byKey[key].enabled then active = true end
        end
        local target = currentHumanoid()
        moveHud.Visible = alive and active and target ~= nil and target.Health > 0
        if not moveHud.Visible then
            verticalHeld.up, verticalHeld.down = false, false
            heldPointers = {}
        end
    end

    local characterConnections = {}
    local function attachCharacter(character)
        local target = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if not alive or not target or LocalPlayer.Character ~= character then return end
        disconnectList(characterConnections)
        characterConnections = {}
        for _, state in ipairs(states) do restoreFeature(state, true) end
        humanoid = target
        if QuickPlus then QuickPlus.characterReset() end
        for _, state in ipairs(states) do
            if state.enabled and state.rig and state.rig ~= target.RigType then
                state.setEnabled(false)
            end
            if not state.enabled and not state.edited and
               (state.key == "WalkSpeed" or state.key == "JumpPower") then
                state.setValue(state.key == "WalkSpeed" and target.WalkSpeed or target.JumpPower, false)
            end
            applyFeature(state)
            state.repaint()
        end
        table.insert(characterConnections, target.Died:Connect(function()
            if humanoid ~= target then return end
            for _, state in ipairs(states) do restoreFeature(state, true) end
            updateMovementHud()
        end))
        updateMovementHud()
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function(character) task.spawn(attachCharacter, character) end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
        if humanoid and humanoid:IsDescendantOf(character) then
            disconnectList(characterConnections)
            characterConnections = {}
            for _, state in ipairs(states) do restoreFeature(state, true) end
            humanoid = nil
            if QuickPlus then QuickPlus.characterReset() end
            updateMovementHud()
        end
    end)
    if LocalPlayer.Character then task.spawn(attachCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character) end

    connect(UserInputService.JumpRequest, function()
        if QuickPlus then QuickPlus.noteJump() end
        if not performWallHop() then performUnlimitedJump() end
    end)
    connect(RunService.PreSimulation, stepMovement)
    local uiElapsed = 0
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(delta)
        if QuickPlus then QuickPlus.heartbeat(delta) end
        uiElapsed = uiElapsed + delta
        if uiElapsed < 0.15 then return end
        uiElapsed = 0
        updateMovementHud()
        if not page.Visible or not MainWindow.Visible then return end
        for _, state in ipairs(states) do
            if state.enabled then state.repaint() end
        end
    end)

    -- Tool.Activated owns teleport input; no global world-click listener remains.
    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not drag or not page.Visible or not MainWindow.Visible then return end
        local pointer = drag.input
        if (pointer.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == pointer) or
           (pointer.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            drag.slide(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        for direction, pointer in pairs(heldPointers) do
            if input == pointer then verticalHeld[direction] = false; heldPointers[direction] = nil end
        end
        if not drag then return end
        if input == drag.input or
           (drag.input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
            stopDragging()
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
        stopDragging()
        verticalHeld.up, verticalHeld.down = false, false
        heldPointers = {}
    end)

    local function updateAnimationVisibility()
        stopDragging()
        local visible = page.Visible and MainWindow.Visible
        for _, feature in ipairs(featureCards) do
            if visible then feature.animation:Play() else feature.animation:Pause() end
        end
        if not visible then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(page:GetDescendants()) do
                if descendant:IsA("TextBox") and descendant:IsFocused() then descendant:ReleaseFocus() end
            end
        end
    end
    connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), updateAnimationVisibility)
    connect(MainWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), updateAnimationVisibility)
    updateAnimationVisibility()

    connect(MainGui.Destroying, function()
        alive = false
        stopDragging()
        disconnectList(characterConnections)
        verticalHeld.up, verticalHeld.down = false, false
        for _, state in ipairs(states) do state.enabled = false; restoreFeature(state) end
        if QuickPlus then QuickPlus.shutdown() end
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do cancelTween(row.tween) end
        for _, feature in ipairs(featureCards) do feature.cancel() end
        for _, animation in ipairs(animations) do animation:Cancel() end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    end)
end)()
end

    byId = {
    },
}
do
    local function add(group, target, prop, label, kind, value, min, max, step, help, optional)
        if kind == "boolean" and type(min) == "string" and help == nil then
            help = min
            min = nil
        end
        local d = {
            id = target .. "." .. prop,
            group = group,
            target = target,
            prop = prop,
            label = label,
            kind = kind,
            default = value,
            min = min,
            max = max,
            step = step or 0.01,
            help = help,
            optional = optional,
        }
        table.insert(VisualSchema.fields, d)
        ;
        VisualSchema.byId[d.id] = d
    end

-- Audited local shader controller. Preset data only; no pshade UI/loaders/checks/feedback.
RedTelemetry.Visuals = (function()
    local api = {
        enabled = false,
        closed = false,
        name = "GAME ORIGINAL",
        revision = 0,
        errors = {
        },
    }
    local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local world = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local terrain = world:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
    local quality
    ;
    pcall(function()
        quality = UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")
    end)
    local classes = {
        Color = "ColorCorrectionEffect",
        Bloom = "BloomEffect",
        DOF = "DepthOfFieldEffect",
        Blur = "BlurEffect",
        SunRays = "SunRaysEffect",
        Motion = "BlurEffect",
        Sky = "Sky",
        Atmosphere = "Atmosphere",
        Clouds = "Clouds",
    }
    local effects, owned, records, connections, values, initial, slots = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local reflectQueue, reflectSeen, reflectHead = {
    }, {
    }, 1
    local giFolder, giLights, giIndex = nil, {
    }, 0
    local flareRoot, flareImages = nil, {
    }
    local lastLook, filteredBlur, pulse, giPulse, flarePulse = nil, 0, 0, 0, 0
    local function copy(t)
        local r = {
        }
        ;
        for k, v in pairs(t) do
            r[k] = v
        end
        ;
        return r
    end
    local function finite(x)
        return type(x) == "number" and x == x and math.abs(x) < math.huge
    end
    local function read(object, key)
        if not object then
            return nil
        end
        ;
        local ok, v = pcall(function()
            return object[key]
        end)
        ;
        if ok then
            return v
        end
    end
    local function put(object, key, value)
        if not object then
            return false
        end
        ;
        return pcall(function()
            object[key] = value
        end)
    end
    local function existing(target)
        if target == "Lighting" then
            return lighting
        elseif target == "Terrain" then
            return terrain
        elseif target == "Quality" then
            return quality
        end
        local class = classes[target]
        if class then
            local parent = lighting
            ;
            if target == "Clouds" then
                parent = terrain
            end
            ;
            return parent and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(class)
        end
    end
    local function rawValue(d)
        local v = read(existing(d.target), d.prop)
        if d.target == "Quality" then
            return v and v.Value or nil
        end
        return v
    end
    local listeners, watchTargets = {
    }, {
    }
    local nextListener = 0
    local bindObjects, unbindObjects
    local applying = false
    local atmosphereParking
    local baseValues
    local resetState
    local driftPending = false
    local driftPulse = 0
    api.overrideCount = 0
    api.contextRevision = 0
    api.baseName = "GAME ORIGINAL"
    api.baseId = nil
    api.skyName = "Game Original"
    api.dirty = {
    }
    api.dirtyCount = 0
    local function replaceValues(source)
        for key in pairs(values) do
            values[key] = nil
        end
        for key, value in pairs(source) do
            values[key] = value
        end
        api.values = values
    end
    local function same(a, b)
        if a == b then
            return true
        end
        if type(a) == "number" and type(b) == "number" then
            return math.abs(a - b) < 1e-05
        end
        local kind = typeof(a)
        if kind == "Color3" and typeof(b) == "Color3" then
            return math.abs(a.R - b.R) < 1e-05 and math.abs(a.G - b.G) < 1e-05 and math.abs(a.B - b.B) < 1e-05
        end
        if kind == "Vector3" and typeof(b) == "Vector3" then
            return (a - b).Magnitude < 1e-05
        end
        return false
    end
    local function updateDirty()
        api.dirty = {
        }
        ;
        api.dirtyCount = 0
        for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
            if d.kind ~= "readonly" and baseValues and not same(values[d.id], baseValues[d.id]) then
                api.dirty[d.id] = true
                ;
                api.dirtyCount = api.dirtyCount + 1
            end
        end
        api.name = api.baseName .. (api.dirtyCount > 0 and " / CUSTOM" or "")
    end
    local function publish(reason, changed)
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[entry[1]] == entry[2] then
                local ok, err = pcall(entry[2], reason, changed or {
                }, api.revision)
                if not ok then
                    api.lastBindingError = tostring(err):sub(1, 180)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if type(fn) ~= "function" or api.closed then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        nextListener = nextListener + 1
        local id = nextListener
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        local connection = {
            Connected = true,
        }
        function connection:Disconnect()
            if not self.Connected then
                return 
            end
            self.Connected = false
            ;
            listeners[id] = nil
        end
        return connection
    end
    local function newContext(name, id)
        api.baseName = name
        ;
        api.baseId = id
        baseValues = copy(values)
        api.contextRevision = api.contextRevision + 1
        updateDirty()
    end
    local function dependency(id)
        local d = VisualSchema.byId[id]
        if not d then
            return nil
        end
        if d.prop ~= "Enabled" and (d.target == "Color" or d.target == "Bloom" or d.target == "DOF" or d.target == "Blur" or d.target == "SunRays" or d.target == "Clouds") then
            return d.target .. ".Enabled"
        end
        if id == "Lighting.FogStart" or id == "Lighting.FogEnd" or id == "Lighting.FogColor" then
            return "FX.FogEnabled"
        end
        if id == "Quality.SavedQualityLevel" then
            return "FX.ManageQuality"
        end
        local gates = {
            ["Lighting.ShadowSoftness"] = "Lighting.GlobalShadows",
            ["Sky.SunAngularSize"] = "Sky.CelestialBodiesShown",
            ["Sky.MoonAngularSize"] = "Sky.CelestialBodiesShown",
            ["Sky.SunTextureId"] = "Sky.CelestialBodiesShown",
            ["Sky.MoonTextureId"] = "Sky.CelestialBodiesShown",
            ["FX.Reflectance"] = "FX.ReflectEnabled",
            ["FX.CycleMinutes"] = "FX.AutoCycle",
            ["FX.MotionStrength"] = "FX.MotionEnabled",
            ["FX.MotionCap"] = "FX.MotionEnabled",
            ["FX.FlareIntensity"] = "FX.FlareEnabled",
            ["FX.FlareSize"] = "FX.FlareEnabled",
            ["FX.GICount"] = "FX.GIEnabled",
            ["FX.GIBrightness"] = "FX.GIEnabled",
            ["FX.GIRange"] = "FX.GIEnabled",
            ["FX.GIRadius"] = "FX.GIEnabled",
        }
        return gates[id]
    end
    function api.dependency(id)
        return dependency(id)
    end
    local skyProbe
    if not existing("Sky") then
        pcall(function()
            skyProbe = Instance.new("Sky")
        end)
    end
    local optionalSupport = {
    }
    for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
        local value = rawValue(d)
        if value == nil and d.target == "Sky" and skyProbe then
            value = read(skyProbe, d.prop)
        end
        if d.optional then
            optionalSupport[d.id] = value ~= nil
        end
        if d.kind == "readonly" then
            value = value ~= nil and tostring(value) or "UNAVAILABLE / ENGINE CONTROLLED"
        elseif value == nil then
            value = d.default
        end
        values[d.id] = value
        ;
        initial[d.id] = value
    end
    if skyProbe then
        skyProbe:Destroy()
        ;
        skyProbe = nil
    end
    api.values, api.initial, api.schema = values, initial, VisualSchema
    baseValues = copy(values)
    local function force(object, key, value)
        if not object then
            return false
        end
        local current = read(object, key)
        if current == nil then
            return false
        end
        if owned[object] then
            if same(current, value) then
                return true
            end
            ;
            return put(object, key, value)
        end
        local r = records[object]
        ;
        if not r then
            r = {
            }
            ;
            records[object] = r
        end
        if not r[key] then
            r[key] = {
                original = current,
            }
        end
        if same(current, value) then
            r[key].forced = current
            ;
            return true
        end
        local ok = put(object, key, value)
        if ok then
            r[key].forced = read(object, key)
        end
        return ok
    end
    local function restore(filter)
        for object, props in pairs(records) do
            for key, r in pairs(props) do
                if not filter or filter(object, key) then
                    local current = read(object, key)
                    if current == r.forced then
                        put(object, key, r.original)
                    end
                    props[key] = nil
                end
            end
            if not next(props) then
                records[object] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    local function create(class, parent)
        local ok, obj = pcall(function()
            return Instance.new(class)
        end)
        if not ok then
            return nil
        end
        owned[obj] = true
        ;
        obj.Name = "DEATH_NOTE_VISUALS_" .. class
        ;
        obj.Parent = parent
        return obj
    end
    local function ensureEffects()
        for target, class in pairs(classes) do
            if not effects[target] or not effects[target].Parent then
                local old = effects[target]
                if old and owned[old] then
                    owned[old] = nil
                    ;
                    pcall(function()
                        old:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                local parent = lighting
                ;
                if target == "Clouds" then
                    parent = terrain
                end
                if parent then
                    if target == "Sky" or target == "Atmosphere" or target == "Clouds" then
                        effects[target] = existing(target) or create(class, parent)
                    else
                        effects[target] = create(class, parent)
                    end
                    if target == "Motion" and effects[target] then
                        put(effects[target], "Enabled", false)
                        ;
                        put(effects[target], "Size", 0)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function suppressGameFX(node)
        if not api.enabled or owned[node] then
            return 
        end
        if node:IsA("PostEffect") then
            force(node, "Enabled", false)
        end
    end
    local function protect(node)
        local c = node
        while c and c ~= world do
            if owned[c] or c:IsA("Tool") or (c:IsA("Model") and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) then
                return true
            end
            c = c.Parent
        end
        return false
    end
    local function queue(node)
        if node and not reflectSeen[node] then
            reflectSeen[node] = true
            ;
            table.insert(reflectQueue, node)
        end
    end
    local function restartReflect()
        reflectQueue, reflectSeen, reflectHead = {
        }, {
        }, 1
        if api.enabled and values["FX.ReflectEnabled"] then
            queue(world)
        else
            restore(function(object, key)
                return key == "Reflectance" and object:IsA("BasePart")
            end)
        end
    end
    local function pumpReflect()
        if not api.enabled or not values["FX.ReflectEnabled"] then
            return 
        end
        local stop = os.clock() + 0.002
        ;
        local count = 0
        while reflectHead <= #reflectQueue and count < 40 and os.clock() <= stop do
            local node = reflectQueue[reflectHead]
            ;
            reflectHead = reflectHead + 1
            ;
            count = count + 1
            if node and node.Parent and not protect(node) then
                if node:IsA("BasePart") and not node:IsA("Terrain") then
                    force(node, "Reflectance", values["FX.Reflectance"])
                end
                for _, child in ipairs(node:GetChildren()) do
                    queue(child)
                end
            end
        end
        if reflectHead > #reflectQueue then
            reflectQueue, reflectSeen, reflectHead = {
            }, {
            }, 1
        end
    end
    local function clearGI()
        if giFolder then
            owned[giFolder] = nil
            ;
            giFolder:Destroy()
            ;
            giFolder = nil
        end
        for _, pair in ipairs(giLights) do
            owned[pair.part] = nil
            ;
            owned[pair.light] = nil
        end
        giLights = {
        }
        ;
        giIndex = 0
    end
    local function stepGI()
        if not values["FX.GIEnabled"] then
            if giFolder then
                clearGI()
            end
            ;
            return 
        end
        local cam = world.CurrentCamera
        ;
        if not cam then
            return 
        end
        local count = math.floor(values["FX.GICount"])
        if not giFolder then
            giFolder = create("Folder", world)
        end
        while #giLights > count do
            local pair = table.remove(giLights)
            ;
            owned[pair.part], owned[pair.light] = nil, nil
            ;
            pair.part:Destroy()
        end
        if #giLights < count then
            local part = create("Part", giFolder)
            part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanTouch, part.CanQuery, part.Transparency = true, false, false, false, 1
            part.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
            ;
            part.CastShadow = false
            local light = create("PointLight", part)
            ;
            light.Shadows = false
            ;
            light.Brightness = 0
            table.insert(giLights, {
                part = part,
                light = light,
            })
        end
        if #giLights == 0 then
            return 
        end
        giIndex = giIndex % #giLights + 1
        local pair = giLights[giIndex]
        ;
        local theta = (giIndex / count) * math.pi * 2
        local pos = cam.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(theta) * values["FX.GIRadius"], 8, math.sin(theta) * values["FX.GIRadius"])
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        ;
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local ignored = {
            giFolder,
        }
        ;
        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            table.insert(ignored, LocalPlayer.Character)
        end
        ;
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
        local hit = world:Raycast(pos, Vector3.new(0, -64, 0), params)
        pair.light.Brightness = 0
        if hit then
            pair.part.Position = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
            pair.light.Color = read(hit.Instance, "Color") or values["Lighting.OutdoorAmbient"]
            pair.light.Range = values["FX.GIRange"]
            ;
            pair.light.Brightness = values["FX.GIBrightness"]
        end
    end
    local function ensureFlare()
        if flareRoot then
            return 
        end
        flareRoot = Instance.new("Frame")
        ;
        flareRoot.Name = "VisualsLensFX"
        ;
        flareRoot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        ;
        flareRoot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ;
        flareRoot.Active = false
        ;
        flareRoot.ZIndex = 0
        ;
        flareRoot.Parent = MainGui
        for i = 1, 5 do
            local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            ;
            image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ;
            image.Image = i == 1 and "rbxassetid://277033149" or "rbxassetid://15164863822"
            image.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 210)
            ;
            image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ;
            image.ImageTransparency = 1
            ;
            image.Visible = false
            ;
            image.Active = false
            ;
            image.ZIndex = 0
            ;
            image.Parent = flareRoot
            table.insert(flareImages, image)
        end
    end
    local function stepFlare()
        if not values["FX.FlareEnabled"] then
            if flareRoot then
                flareRoot.Visible = false
            end
            ;
            return 
        end
        ensureFlare()
        ;
        flareRoot.Visible = true
        local cam = world.CurrentCamera
        ;
        if not cam then
            flareRoot.Visible = false
            ;
            return 
        end
        local sun = lighting:GetSunDirection()
        ;
        local point, front = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(cam.CFrame.Position + sun * 1000)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        ;
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local ignored = {
        }
        ;
        if giFolder then
            table.insert(ignored, giFolder)
        end
        ;
        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            table.insert(ignored, LocalPlayer.Character)
        end
        ;
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
        local blocked = world:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, sun * 1000, params)
        local visible = front and sun.Y > 0 and not blocked
        local center = cam.ViewportSize / 2
        ;
        local direction = Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y) - center
        for i, image in ipairs(flareImages) do
            local factor = ({
                1,
                1.7,
                0.3,
                -0.3,
                -0.9,
            })[i]
            ;
            local p = center + direction * factor
            local size = (i == 1 and 220 or 45 + i * 10) * values["FX.FlareSize"]
            image.Position = UDim2.new(0, p.X, 0, p.Y)
            ;
            image.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
            image.ImageTransparency = 1 - values["FX.FlareIntensity"] * (i == 1 and 1 or 0.35)
            image.Visible = not not visible
        end
    end
    function api.supported(d)
        if type(d) == "string" then
            d = VisualSchema.byId[d]
        end
        if not d then
            return false
        end
        if d.target == "FX" then
            return true
        end
        if d.target == "Terrain" or d.target == "Clouds" then
            if not terrain then
                return false
            end
        end
        if d.target == "Quality" then
            return quality ~= nil
        end
        if d.optional then
            return optionalSupport[d.id]
        end
        if d.target == "Lighting" then
            return rawValue(d) ~= nil
        end
        return true
    end
    local function targetObject(d)
        if d.target == "Lighting" then
            return lighting
        end
        if d.target == "Terrain" then
            return terrain
        end
        if d.target == "Quality" then
            return quality
        end
        return effects[d.target]
    end
    local function liveValue(d)
        local value = read(targetObject(d), d.prop)
        if d.target == "Quality" then
            return value and value.Value or nil
        end
        return value
    end
    function api.read(id)
        local d = VisualSchema.byId[id]
        if not d then
            return nil, "Unknown setting"
        end
        if d.target == "FX" then
            return values[id]
        end
        return liveValue(d)
    end
    function api.status(id)
        local d = VisualSchema.byId[id]
        if not d then
            return "UNKNOWN"
        end
        if d.kind == "readonly" then
            return "READ ONLY / ENGINE CONTROLLED"
        end
        if not api.supported(d) then
            return "UNAVAILABLE ON THIS CLIENT"
        end
        if not api.enabled then
            return "STAGED / SHADERS OFF"
        end
        if api.errors[id] then
            return "BLOCKED / " .. api.errors[id]
        end
        local gate = dependency(id)
        if gate and not values[gate] then
            return "INACTIVE / ENABLE " .. (VisualSchema.byId[gate].label or gate)
        end
        if d.target == "Atmosphere" and values["FX.FogEnabled"] then
            return "INACTIVE / CLASSIC FOG MODE"
        end
        if d.target == "FX" then
            return "LIVE / LOCAL"
        end
        local actual = liveValue(d)
        if actual ~= nil and same(actual, values[id]) then
            return "APPLIED / LIVE"
        end
        return "WAITING / GAME OVERRIDE"
    end
    function api.explain(id)
        local d = VisualSchema.byId[id]
        if not d then
            return "Unknown field"
        end
        if d.target == "Terrain" then
            return "Only native Terrain water is affected; mesh/part water is not Terrain water."
        end
        if d.target == "Clouds" then
            return "Terrain clouds need Terrain, a visible sky and nonzero cover/density; indoor scenes can hide them."
        end
        if d.target == "DOF" then
            return "Depth of field depends on depth, focus distance and client graphics support; a flat/uniform scene may show little change."
        end
        if d.target == "Bloom" then
            return "Bloom needs sufficiently bright pixels above its threshold and supported client quality."
        end
        if d.target == "SunRays" then
            return "Sun rays need the sun/bright sky in view and supported client graphics."
        end
        if id == "Lighting.ShadowSoftness" or id == "Lighting.GlobalShadows" then
            return "Shadows need shadow-casting geometry and a compatible renderer/quality. Renderer technology is not client-writable."
        end
        if id == "FX.FlareEnabled" or id == "FX.FlareIntensity" or id == "FX.FlareSize" then
            return "Flare appears only with the sun in view, above the horizon and without raycast obstruction."
        end
        if id == "FX.MotionEnabled" or id == "FX.MotionStrength" or id == "FX.MotionCap" then
            return "Motion blur responds to camera rotation; a stationary camera should remain sharp."
        end
        if id:sub(1, 5) == "FX.GI" then
            return "Local bounded point lights require raycast surface hits. This is not engine GI or ray tracing."
        end
        if d.target == "Sky" then
            return "Roblox asset visibility/moderation and streaming are game-controlled. Texture changes are not guaranteed asset access."
        end
        if d.kind == "readonly" then
            return "Engine-controlled property; intentionally no hidden-property writes."
        end
        return "Applies locally. Other game scripts can override local properties; enable Realtime Shader Lock to reassert supported values."
    end
    local function printable(value)
        if typeof(value) == "Color3" then
            return string.format("RGB(%d,%d,%d)", math.floor(value.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(value.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(value.B * 255 + 0.5))
        end
        if typeof(value) == "Vector3" then
            return string.format("XYZ(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f)", value.X, value.Y, value.Z)
        end
        return tostring(value)
    end
    function api.audit()
        local result = {
            fields = {
            },
            total = 0,
            matched = 0,
            blocked = 0,
            inactive = 0,
        }
        for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
            local status = api.status(d.id)
            local actual = api.read(d.id)
            local entry = {
                id = d.id,
                requested = printable(values[d.id]),
                actual = printable(actual),
                status = status,
                note = api.explain(d.id),
            }
            result.total = result.total + 1
            if status:find("APPLIED", 1, true) or status == "LIVE / LOCAL" then
                result.matched = result.matched + 1
            elseif status:find("BLOCKED", 1, true) or status:find("WAITING", 1, true) then
                result.blocked = result.blocked + 1
            else
                result.inactive = result.inactive + 1
            end
            result.fields[#result.fields + 1] = entry
        end
        return result
    end
    function api.report()
        local audit = api.audit()
        local out = {
            "VISUALS V19 / LOCAL PROPERTY DIAGNOSTICS",
            "Preset: " .. api.baseName,
            "Master: " .. tostring(api.enabled) .. " | Edit count: " .. api.dirtyCount,
            "Matched: " .. audit.matched .. " / " .. audit.total .. " | blocked/overridden: " .. audit.blocked,
            "Property readback is not proof of GPU rendering or universal asset permission.",
            "",
        }
        for _, entry in ipairs(audit.fields) do
            out[#out + 1] = entry.id .. " | " .. entry.status
            out[#out + 1] = "  requested=" .. entry.requested .. " | actual=" .. entry.actual
            out[#out + 1] = "  " .. entry.note
        end
        return table.concat(out, "\n")
    end
    local function fogAtmospheres()
        if values["FX.FogEnabled"] then
            if not atmosphereParking or not atmosphereParking.Parent then
                atmosphereParking = create("Folder", world)
                ;
                atmosphereParking.Name = "DEATH_NOTE_VISUALS_FOG_PARKING"
            end
            for _, node in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if node:IsA("Atmosphere") then
                    force(node, "Parent", atmosphereParking)
                end
            end
        else
            restore(function(object, key)
                return key == "Parent" and object:IsA("Atmosphere")
            end)
            if effects.Atmosphere and owned[effects.Atmosphere] and effects.Atmosphere.Parent ~= lighting then
                put(effects.Atmosphere, "Parent", lighting)
            end
        end
    end
    function api.apply()
        if not api.enabled or api.closed or applying then
            return 
        end
        applying = true
        local ok, reason = pcall(function()
            ensureEffects()
            ;
            api.errors = {
            }
            for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
                if d.target ~= "FX" and d.kind ~= "readonly" then
                    local object = targetObject(d)
                    local value = values[d.id]
                    ;
                    local skip = false
                    if d.target == "Quality" then
                        skip = not values["FX.ManageQuality"]
                        value = value == 0 and Enum.SavedQualitySetting.Automatic or Enum.SavedQualitySetting["QualityLevel" .. tostring(math.floor(value))]
                    elseif d.prop == "FogStart" or d.prop == "FogEnd" then
                        if not values["FX.FogEnabled"] then
                            value = 1000000000
                        end
                        if values["FX.FogEnabled"] and d.prop == "FogEnd" then
                            value = math.max(value, values["Lighting.FogStart"] + 1)
                        end
                    end
                    if not skip then
                        if not force(object, d.prop, value) then
                            api.errors[d.id] = "CLIENT REJECTED PROPERTY WRITE"
                        elseif not ((d.prop == "FogStart" or d.prop == "FogEnd") and not values["FX.FogEnabled"]) then
                            local actual = liveValue(d)
                            if actual ~= nil and not same(actual, values[d.id]) then
                                api.errors[d.id] = "WRITE DID NOT STICK / ENGINE OR GAME OVERRIDE"
                                api.overrideCount = api.overrideCount + 1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not values["FX.ManageQuality"] then
                restore(function(object, key)
                    return object == quality and key == "SavedQualityLevel"
                end)
            end
            fogAtmospheres()
            for _, node in ipairs(lighting:GetDescendants()) do
                suppressGameFX(node)
            end
            local cam = world.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                for _, node in ipairs(cam:GetDescendants()) do
                    suppressGameFX(node)
                end
            end
            if bindObjects then
                bindObjects()
            end
        end)
        applying = false
        if not ok then
            api.runtimeWarning = tostring(reason):sub(1, 160)
            ;
            return false, api.runtimeWarning
        end
        return true
    end
    function api.disable()
        api.enabled = false
        ;
        driftPending = false
        ;
        driftPulse = 0
        if unbindObjects then
            unbindObjects()
        end
        reflectQueue, reflectSeen, reflectHead = {
        }, {
        }, 1
        restore()
        ;
        clearGI()
        for object in pairs(owned) do
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        owned = {
        }
        ;
        effects = {
        }
        ;
        atmosphereParking = nil
        if flareRoot then
            flareRoot:Destroy()
            ;
            flareRoot = nil
            ;
            flareImages = {
            }
        end
        lastLook, filteredBlur = nil, 0
        publish("disabled")
    end
    function api.enable()
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Visuals closed"
        end
        if api.enabled then
            return true
        end
        if RedTelemetry.StopQuickGraphics then
            RedTelemetry.StopQuickGraphics()
        end
        api.enabled = true
        local applied, reason = api.apply()
        if applied == false then
            api.disable()
            ;
            return false, reason
        end
        restartReflect()
        ;
        publish("enabled")
        return true
    end
    function api.validate(id, value)
        local d = VisualSchema.byId[id]
        ;
        if not d or d.kind == "readonly" then
            return nil, "Unknown/read-only setting"
        end
        if d.kind == "number" then
            if id == "Lighting.ClockTime" and type(value) == "string" then
                local h, m = value:match("^(%d%d?):(%d%d)$")
                ;
                if h and tonumber(h) < 24 and tonumber(m) < 60 then
                    value = tonumber(h) + tonumber(m) / 60
                end
            end
            local n = tonumber(value)
            ;
            if not finite(n) then
                return nil, "Enter a finite number"
            end
            n = math.clamp(n, d.min, d.max)
            if id == "Lighting.ClockTime" then
                n = n % 24
            end
            if id == "Quality.SavedQualityLevel" or id == "FX.GICount" or id == "Sky.StarCount" then
                n = math.floor(n + 0.5)
            end
            return n
        elseif d.kind == "boolean" then
            if type(value) ~= "boolean" then
                return nil, "Use ON/OFF"
            end
            ;
            return value
        elseif d.kind == "color" then
            local ok, r, g, b = pcall(function()
                return value.R, value.G, value.B
            end)
            if not ok or not finite(r) or not finite(g) or not finite(b) then
                return nil, "Use RGB / HEX"
            end
            return Color3.new(math.clamp(r, 0, 1), math.clamp(g, 0, 1), math.clamp(b, 0, 1))
        elseif d.kind == "vector" then
            local ok, x, y, z = pcall(function()
                return value.X, value.Y, value.Z
            end)
            if not ok or not finite(x) or not finite(y) or not finite(z) then
                return nil, "Enter three finite axes"
            end
            return Vector3.new(math.clamp(x, -360, 360), math.clamp(y, -360, 360), math.clamp(z, -360, 360))
        elseif d.kind == "asset" then
            if type(value) ~= "string" and type(value) ~= "number" then
                return nil, "Enter a Roblox asset ID"
            end
            value = tostring(value):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            if value == "" then
                return ""
            end
            local id = value:match("^(%d+)$") or value:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")
            if id and tonumber(id) > 0 then
                return "rbxassetid://" .. id
            end
            if value:match("^rbxasset://[%w_/%-%.]+$") then
                return value
            end
            return nil, "Use a positive Roblox asset ID, not a URL or code"
        end
    end
    function api.set(id, value, editor)
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Visuals closed"
        end
        local v, reason = api.validate(id, value)
        if v == nil then
            return false, reason
        end
        local d = VisualSchema.byId[id]
        if editor and not api.supported(d) then
            return false, "This property is not supported on this client"
        end
        local before = copy(values)
        local changed = {
            [id] = true,
        }
        values[id] = v
        api.lastAutoEnabled = nil
        if editor then
            local gate = dependency(id)
            if gate and not values[gate] then
                values[gate] = true
                ;
                changed[gate] = true
                ;
                api.lastAutoEnabled = gate
            end
            if id == "Lighting.ClockTime" and values["FX.AutoCycle"] then
                values["FX.AutoCycle"] = false
                ;
                changed["FX.AutoCycle"] = true
            end
            if d.target == "Atmosphere" and values["FX.FogEnabled"] then
                values["FX.FogEnabled"] = false
                ;
                changed["FX.FogEnabled"] = true
            end
        end
        if d.target == "Sky" then
            api.skySelected = true
            ;
            api.skyName = "Custom Sky"
        end
        if id == "Lighting.FogStart" then
            values["Lighting.FogEnd"] = math.max(values["Lighting.FogEnd"], v + 1)
            ;
            changed["Lighting.FogEnd"] = true
        elseif id == "Lighting.FogEnd" then
            values[id] = math.max(v, values["Lighting.FogStart"] + 1)
        end
        if api.enabled then
            local applied, applyReason = api.apply()
            if applied == false or api.errors[id] then
                local failed = api.errors[id] or applyReason or "Client rejected this change"
                replaceValues(before)
                ;
                api.apply()
                ;
                updateDirty()
                ;
                publish("rejected", changed)
                return false, failed
            end
            if changed["FX.ReflectEnabled"] or changed["FX.Reflectance"] then
                restartReflect()
            end
            if not values["FX.GIEnabled"] then
                clearGI()
            end
        end
        updateDirty()
        ;
        publish(editor and "edit" or "set", changed)
        return true, api.enabled and "APPLIED" or "STAGED"
    end
    function api.edit(id, value)
        local before = copy(values)
        local wasOff = not api.enabled
        local ok, reason = api.set(id, value, true)
        if not ok then
            return false, reason
        end
        if wasOff and values["FX.AutoPreview"] and id ~= "FX.AutoPreview" then
            local enabled, why = api.enable()
            if not enabled or api.errors[id] then
                local failure = api.errors[id] or why or "Unable to preview this setting"
                api.disable()
                ;
                replaceValues(before)
                ;
                updateDirty()
                ;
                publish("rejected", {
                    [id] = true,
                })
                return false, failure
            end
        end
        return true, api.enabled and "APPLIED" or "STAGED"
    end
    local function captureReset()
        resetState = {
            values = copy(values),
            name = api.baseName,
            id = api.baseId,
            skyName = api.skyName,
        }
    end
    function api.resetShader()
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Visuals closed"
        end
        if not resetState then
            return false, "Select a shader or load a profile first"
        end
        local before = copy(values)
        replaceValues(resetState.values)
        api.baseName = resetState.name
        ;
        api.baseId = resetState.id
        ;
        api.skyName = resetState.skyName
        baseValues = copy(resetState.values)
        api.contextRevision = api.contextRevision + 1
        local ok, reason = api.enable()
        if not ok then
            replaceValues(before)
            ;
            updateDirty()
            ;
            publish("reset-failed")
            ;
            return false, reason
        end
        local applied, why = api.apply()
        restartReflect()
        ;
        if not values["FX.GIEnabled"] then
            clearGI()
        end
        updateDirty()
        ;
        publish("reset-shader")
        if applied == false then
            return false, why
        end
        return true, "FULL SHADER RESTORED"
    end
    function api.resetGroup(group)
        local changed = {
        }
        for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
            if d.group == group and d.kind ~= "readonly" then
                values[d.id] = (resetState and resetState.values or baseValues or initial)[d.id]
                ;
                changed[d.id] = true
            end
        end
        api.contextRevision = api.contextRevision + 1
        if api.enabled then
            api.apply()
            ;
            restartReflect()
            ;
            if not values["FX.GIEnabled"] then
                clearGI()
            end
        end
        updateDirty()
        ;
        publish("reset-section", changed)
    end
    function api.original()
        api.disable()
        if RedTelemetry.StopQuickGraphics then
            RedTelemetry.StopQuickGraphics()
        end
        resetState = nil
        ;
        replaceValues(initial)
        ;
        api.skySelected = false
        ;
        api.skyName = "Game Original"
        newContext("GAME ORIGINAL", nil)
        ;
        publish("original")
    end
    function api.preset(id)
        local selected
        for _, p in ipairs(VisualPresetData.presets) do
            if p.id == id then
                selected = p
                ;
                break
            end
        end
        if not selected then
            return false, "Unknown preset"
        end
        -- A complete baseline prevents old toggles/custom edits leaking into the next look.
        local nextValues = copy(initial)
        if api.skySelected then
            for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
                if d.target == "Sky" then
                    nextValues[d.id] = values[d.id]
                end
            end
        else
            for key, value in pairs(VisualPresetData.skies[#VisualPresetData.skies].values) do
                nextValues[key] = value
            end
        end
        for key, value in pairs(selected.values) do
            local v = api.validate(key, value)
            if v ~= nil then
                nextValues[key] = v
            end
        end
        if not api.skySelected then
            api.skyName = "PShade Default"
        end
        replaceValues(nextValues)
        ;
        api.skySelected = true
        newContext(selected.name, selected.id)
        local ok, reason = api.enable()
        if not ok then
            return false, reason
        end
        api.apply()
        ;
        restartReflect()
        ;
        if not values["FX.GIEnabled"] then
            clearGI()
        end
        baseValues = copy(values)
        ;
        captureReset()
        ;
        updateDirty()
        ;
        publish("preset")
        return true
    end
    function api.sky(name)
        if name == "Game Original" then
            for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
                if d.target == "Sky" then
                    values[d.id] = initial[d.id]
                end
            end
        else
            local found = false
            for _, sky in ipairs(VisualPresetData.skies) do
                if sky.name == name then
                    for key, v in pairs(sky.values) do
                        values[key] = v
                    end
                    ;
                    found = true
                    ;
                    break
                end
            end
            if not found then
                return false, "Unknown sky pack"
            end
        end
        api.skySelected = true
        ;
        api.skyName = name
        if api.baseName == "GAME ORIGINAL" or api.baseName:sub(1, 6) == "SKY / " then
            api.baseName = "SKY / " .. name
        end
        -- A sky selection changes the sky baseline, not the active shader's identity or other edits.
        for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
            if d.target == "Sky" then
                baseValues[d.id] = values[d.id]
            end
        end
        api.contextRevision = api.contextRevision + 1
        api.enable()
        ;
        api.apply()
        ;
        if not resetState then
            captureReset()
        end
        ;
        updateDirty()
        ;
        publish("sky")
        return true
    end
    local function serializeValues()
        local out = {
        }
        for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
            if d.kind ~= "readonly" then
                local v = values[d.id]
                if d.kind == "color" then
                    v = {
                        v.R,
                        v.G,
                        v.B,
                    }
                elseif d.kind == "vector" then
                    v = {
                        v.X,
                        v.Y,
                        v.Z,
                    }
                end
                out[d.id] = v
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    function api.export()
        return HttpService:JSONEncode({
            format = "DEATH_NOTE_VISUALS",
            version = 1,
            name = api.name,
            values = serializeValues(),
        })
    end
    function api.import(raw)
        if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 32000 then
            return false, "Profile must be JSON under 32 KB"
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
        end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or data.format ~= "DEATH_NOTE_VISUALS" or data.version ~= 1 or type(data.values) ~= "table" then
            return false, "Invalid Visuals JSON profile"
        end
        local staged = {
        }
        for id, value in pairs(data.values) do
            local d = VisualSchema.byId[id]
            ;
            if not d or d.kind == "readonly" then
                return false, "Unknown/read-only profile field"
            end
            if d.kind == "color" or d.kind == "vector" then
                if type(value) ~= "table" or #value ~= 3 or not finite(value[1]) or not finite(value[2]) or not finite(value[3]) then
                    return false, "Invalid RGB/XYZ array"
                end
                value = d.kind == "color" and Color3.new(value[1], value[2], value[3]) or Vector3.new(value[1], value[2], value[3])
            end
            local v, reason = api.validate(id, value)
            ;
            if v == nil then
                return false, reason
            end
            ;
            staged[id] = v
        end
        for id, value in pairs(staged) do
            values[id] = value
        end
        api.skySelected = true
        ;
        api.skyName = "Profile Sky"
        ;
        newContext("IMPORTED PROFILE", nil)
        if api.enabled then
            api.apply()
            ;
            restartReflect()
            ;
            if not values["FX.GIEnabled"] then
                clearGI()
            end
        end
        baseValues = copy(values)
        ;
        captureReset()
        ;
        updateDirty()
        ;
        publish("import")
        return true
    end
    function api.saveSlot(id)
        if type(id) ~= "number" or id % 1 ~= 0 or id < 1 or id > 3 then
            return false, "Use a session slot from 1 to 3"
        end
        slots[id] = {
            values = copy(values),
            baseValues = copy(baseValues),
            baseName = api.baseName,
            baseId = api.baseId,
            skyName = api.skyName,
            reset = resetState and {
                values = copy(resetState.values),
                name = resetState.name,
                id = resetState.id,
                skyName = resetState.skyName,
            } or nil,
        }
        return true
    end
    function api.loadSlot(id)
        local slot = slots[id]
        if not slot then
            return false, "Slot is empty / session only"
        end
        resetState = slot.reset and {
            values = copy(slot.reset.values),
            name = slot.reset.name,
            id = slot.reset.id,
            skyName = slot.reset.skyName,
        } or nil
        replaceValues(slot.values)
        ;
        api.skySelected = true
        api.baseName = slot.baseName
        ;
        api.baseId = slot.baseId
        ;
        api.skyName = slot.skyName or "Profile Sky"
        ;
        baseValues = copy(slot.baseValues)
        api.contextRevision = api.contextRevision + 1
        if api.enabled then
            api.apply()
            ;
            restartReflect()
            ;
            if not values["FX.GIEnabled"] then
                clearGI()
            end
        end
        updateDirty()
        ;
        publish("slot")
        return true
    end
    unbindObjects = function()
        for _, watch in pairs(watchTargets) do
            for _, connection in ipairs(watch.connections) do
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end
        watchTargets = {
        }
    end
    bindObjects = function()
        local wanted = {
            Lighting = lighting,
            Terrain = terrain,
            Quality = quality,
        }
        for target, object in pairs(effects) do
            wanted[target] = object
        end
        for target, watch in pairs(watchTargets) do
            if wanted[target] ~= watch.object then
                for _, connection in ipairs(watch.connections) do
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end
                watchTargets[target] = nil
            end
        end
        for target, object in pairs(wanted) do
            if object and not watchTargets[target] then
                local watch = {
                    object = object,
                    connections = {
                    },
                }
                watchTargets[target] = watch
                for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
                    if d.target == target then
                        local field = d
                        local ok, connection = pcall(function()
                            return object:GetPropertyChangedSignal(field.prop):Connect(function()
                                if applying or not api.enabled or api.closed then
                                    return 
                                end
                                local actual = liveValue(field)
                                if actual == nil then
                                    return 
                                end
                                if field.kind == "readonly" then
                                    local new = tostring(actual)
                                    if values[field.id] ~= new then
                                        values[field.id] = new
                                        ;
                                        publish("engine", {
                                            [field.id] = true,
                                        })
                                    end
                                    return 
                                end
                                local gate = dependency(field.id)
                                if gate and not values[gate] then
                                    return 
                                end
                                if same(actual, values[field.id]) then
                                    return 
                                end
                                if values["FX.LiveLock"] then
                                    driftPending = true
                                    api.overrideCount = api.overrideCount + 1
                                else
                                    values[field.id] = actual
                                    ;
                                    updateDirty()
                                    ;
                                    publish("game", {
                                        [field.id] = true,
                                    })
                                end
                            end)
                        end)
                        if ok then
                            table.insert(watch.connections, connection)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function step(delta)
        if not api.enabled or api.closed then
            return 
        end
        delta = math.clamp(delta or 0.016, 0.001, 0.1)
        driftPulse = driftPulse + delta
        if driftPending and driftPulse >= 1 / 30 then
            driftPending = false
            ;
            driftPulse = 0
            ;
            api.apply()
        end
        pumpReflect()
        if values["FX.AutoCycle"] then
            values["Lighting.ClockTime"] = (values["Lighting.ClockTime"] + delta * 24 / (values["FX.CycleMinutes"] * 60)) % 24
            ;
            force(lighting, "ClockTime", values["Lighting.ClockTime"])
        end
        local cam = world.CurrentCamera
        if values["FX.MotionEnabled"] and cam then
            local look = cam.CFrame.LookVector
            local speed = lastLook and (look - lastLook).Magnitude / delta or 0
            filteredBlur = filteredBlur + (math.min(values["FX.MotionCap"], speed * values["FX.MotionStrength"]) - filteredBlur) * (1 - math.exp(-12 * delta))
            if effects.Motion then
                put(effects.Motion, "Enabled", true)
                ;
                put(effects.Motion, "Size", filteredBlur)
            end
            lastLook = look
        else
            lastLook = nil
            ;
            filteredBlur = 0
            ;
            if effects.Motion then
                put(effects.Motion, "Enabled", false)
                ;
                put(effects.Motion, "Size", 0)
            end
        end
        pulse = pulse + delta
        ;
        giPulse = giPulse + delta
        ;
        flarePulse = flarePulse + delta
        if pulse >= 0.5 then
            pulse = 0
            ;
            if values["FX.LiveLock"] then
                api.apply()
            end
            ;
            updateDirty()
            ;
            publish("tick", {
                ["Lighting.ClockTime"] = true,
            })
        end
        if giPulse >= 0.15 then
            giPulse = 0
            ;
            stepGI()
        end
        if flarePulse >= 0.05 then
            flarePulse = 0
            ;
            stepFlare()
        end
    end
    table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
        local ok, reason = pcall(step, delta)
        ;
        if not ok then
            api.runtimeWarning = tostring(reason):sub(1, 110)
        else
            api.runtimeWarning = nil
        end
    end))
    table.insert(connections, lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(suppressGameFX))
    table.insert(connections, world.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(node)
        if not api.enabled then
            return 
        end
        if values["FX.ReflectEnabled"] then
            queue(node)
        end
        if node:IsA("PostEffect") and world.CurrentCamera and node:IsDescendantOf(world.CurrentCamera) then
            suppressGameFX(node)
        end
    end))
    function api.close()
        api.disable()
        ;
        api.closed = true
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(VisualSchema.fields) do
        if not d.help then
            d.help = api.explain(d.id)
        end
    end
    return api
end)()
-- Simple ESP, fixed screen geometry and a readable local body-part expander.
-- No shot interception, auto-aim, remote calls or server-side hit/damage guarantees.
RedTelemetry.VisualOverlay = (function()
    local api = {
        closed = false,
        revision = 0,
        stats = {
            visible = 0,
        },
        runtimeWarning = nil,
    }
    local values = {
        Enabled = false,
        Style = "Outline",
        Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 225, 255),
        MarkerEnabled = false,
        MarkerShape = "Circle",
        MarkerSize = 220,
        ExpanderEnabled = false,
        ExpanderPart = "Root",
        ExpanderSize = 8,
        TeamCheck = true,
    }
    api.values = values
    api.styles = {
        "Outline",
        "Box",
        "Names",
    }
    api.shapes = {
        "Square",
        "Circle",
        "Triangle",
    }
    local world = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local players = game:GetService("Players")
    local folder, markerGui, markerRoot
    local entries, lines, listeners, connections = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local nextListener = 0
    local pulse = 0
    local function finite(n)
        return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function make(
        class,
        name,
        parent
    )
        local object = Instance.new(class)
        ;
        object.Name = name
        ;
        object.Parent = parent
        ;
        return object
    end
    local function publish()
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[entry[1]] == entry[2] then
                pcall(entry[2])
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if api.closed or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        nextListener = nextListener + 1
        ;
        local id = nextListener
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        local handle = {
            Connected = true,
        }
        function handle:Disconnect()
            self.Connected = false
            ;
            listeners[id] = nil
        end
        return handle
    end
    function api.fromHSV(
        h,
        s,
        v
    )
        h = (h % 1) * 6
        ;
        s = math.clamp(
            s,
            0,
            1
        )
        ;
        v = math.clamp(
            v,
            0,
            1
        )
        local c = v * s
        ;
        local x = c * (1 - math.abs(h % 2 - 1))
        ;
        local m = v - c
        local r, g, b = 0, 0, 0
        if h < 1 then
            r, g, b = c, x, 0
        elseif h < 2 then
            r, g, b = x, c, 0
        elseif h < 3 then
            r, g, b = 0, c, x
        elseif h < 4 then
            r, g, b = 0, x, c
        elseif h < 5 then
            r, g, b = x, 0, c
        else
            r, g, b = c, 0, x
        end
        return Color3.new(
            r + m,
            g + m,
            b + m
        )
    end
    function api.toHSV(color)
        local r, g, b = color.R, color.G, color.B
        local hi, lo = math.max(
            r,
            g,
            b), math.min(r,
            g,
            b
        )
        local delta = hi - lo
        ;
        local h = 0
        if delta > 1e-06 then
            if hi == r then
                h = ((g - b) / delta) % 6
            elseif hi == g then
                h = (b - r) / delta + 2
            else
                h = (r - g) / delta + 4
            end
            h = h / 6
        end
        return h, hi > 0 and delta / hi or 0, hi
    end
    local function clearEntry(entry)
        for _, object in pairs(entry) do
            drop(object)
        end
    end
    local function clearESP()
        for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
            clearEntry(entry)
        end
        entries = {
        }
        ;
        drop(folder)
        ;
        folder = nil
        ;
        api.stats.visible = 0
    end
    local function rootOf(model)
        local root = model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Head"))
        return root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root or nil
    end
    local function sameTeam(player)
        local mine = LocalPlayer.Team
        local theirs = player.Team
        return mine ~= nil and theirs ~= nil and mine == theirs and LocalPlayer.Neutral ~= true and player.Neutral ~= true
    end
    local function buildEntry(
        player,
        model,
        root
    )
        if not folder or not folder.Parent then
            folder = make(
                "Folder",
                "DEATH_NOTE_SIMPLE_ESP",
                world
            )
        end
        local entry = {
        }
        if values.Style == "Outline" then
            entry.visual = make(
                "Highlight",
                "SimpleESPOutline",
                folder
            )
            entry.visual.Adornee = model
            ;
            entry.visual.FillTransparency = 1
            ;
            entry.visual.OutlineTransparency = 0
            entry.visual.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        elseif values.Style == "Box" then
            entry.visual = make(
                "SelectionBox",
                "SimpleESPBox",
                folder
            )
            entry.visual.Adornee = model
            ;
            entry.visual.SurfaceTransparency = 1
            ;
            entry.visual.LineThickness = 0.04
            ;
            entry.visual.Transparency = 0
        else
            entry.visual = make(
                "BillboardGui",
                "SimpleESPName",
                folder
            )
            entry.visual.Adornee = model:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
            entry.visual.Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                210,
                0,
                52
            )
            ;
            entry.visual.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(
                0,
                2.2,
                0
            )
            entry.visual.AlwaysOnTop = true
            ;
            entry.visual.LightInfluence = 0
            ;
            entry.visual.MaxDistance = 1200
            entry.text = make(
                "TextLabel",
                "SimpleESPNameText",
                entry.visual
            )
            entry.text.Size = UDim2.new(
                1,
                0,
                1,
                0
            )
            ;
            entry.text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ;
            entry.text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            entry.text.TextSize = 12
            ;
            entry.text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
            ;
            entry.text.TextWrapped = true
        end
        return entry
    end
    local function refreshESP()
        if not values.Enabled then
            clearESP()
            ;
            return 
        end
        if folder and not folder.Parent then
            clearESP()
        end
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then
            return 
        end
        local localRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and rootOf(LocalPlayer.Character)
        local origin = localRoot and localRoot.Position or camera.CFrame.Position
        local candidates = {
        }
        for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
            local model = player.Character
            local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = rootOf(model)
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and not (values.TeamCheck and sameTeam(player)) and model and model.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
                local distance = (root.Position - origin).Magnitude
                if distance <= 1200 then
                    candidates[#candidates + 1] = {
                        player = player,
                        model = model,
                        root = root,
                        humanoid = humanoid,
                        distance = distance,
                    }
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
            return a.distance < b.distance
        end)
        local active = {
        }
        for i = 1, math.min(24, #candidates) do
            local contact = candidates[i]
            ;
            local model = contact.model
            active[model] = true
            local entry = entries[model]
            if entry and (not entry.visual or not entry.visual.Parent) then
                clearEntry(entry)
                ;
                entries[model] = nil
                ;
                entry = nil
            end
            if not entry then
                entry = buildEntry(
                    contact.player,
                    model,
                    contact.root
                )
                ;
                entries[model] = entry
            end
            if values.Style == "Outline" then
                entry.visual.OutlineColor = values.Color
            elseif values.Style == "Box" then
                entry.visual.Color3 = values.Color
            else
                entry.visual.Adornee = model:FindFirstChild("Head") or contact.root
                entry.text.Text = (
                    contact.player.DisplayName or contact.player.Name) .. string.format("\nHP %d/%d",
                    math.floor(contact.humanoid.Health),
                    math.max(1, math.floor(contact.humanoid.MaxHealth or 100))
                )
                entry.text.TextColor3 = values.Color
            end
        end
        for model, entry in pairs(entries) do
            if not active[model] then
                clearEntry(entry)
                ;
                entries[model] = nil
            end
        end
        api.stats.visible = math.min(24, #candidates)
    end
    local function clearMarker()
        drop(markerGui)
        ;
        markerGui = nil
        ;
        markerRoot = nil
        ;
        lines = {
        }
    end
    local function markerVertices()
        if values.MarkerShape == "Square" then
            return {
                {
                    -0.5,
                    -0.5,
                },
                {
                    0.5,
                    -0.5,
                },
                {
                    0.5,
                    0.5,
                },
                {
                    -0.5,
                    0.5,
                },
            }
        end
        if values.MarkerShape == "Triangle" then
            return {
                {
                    0,
                    -0.5,
                },
                {
                    0.5,
                    0.5,
                },
                {
                    -0.5,
                    0.5,
                },
            }
        end
        local points = {
        }
        for i = 0, 71 do
            local a = i / 72 * math.pi * 2
            ;
            points[#points + 1] = {
                math.cos(a) * 0.5,
                math.sin(a) * 0.5,
            }
        end
        return points
    end
    local function refreshMarker()
        if not values.MarkerEnabled then
            clearMarker()
            ;
            return 
        end
        if not markerGui or not markerGui.Parent then
            clearMarker()
            markerGui = make(
                "ScreenGui",
                "DEATH_NOTE_FIXED_VISUAL_SHAPE",
                MainGui.Parent
            )
            markerGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            ;
            markerGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            ;
            markerGui.DisplayOrder = 0
            ;
            markerGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            markerRoot = make(
                "Frame",
                "FixedScreenShape",
                markerGui
            )
            markerRoot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ;
            markerRoot.Position = UDim2.new(
                0.5,
                0,
                0.5,
                0
            )
            markerRoot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ;
            markerRoot.Active = false
        end
        markerRoot.Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            values.MarkerSize,
            0,
            values.MarkerSize
        )
        local vertices = markerVertices()
        for i = 1, #vertices do
            local a, b = vertices[i], vertices[i % #vertices + 1]
            local dx, dy = (b[1] - a[1]) * values.MarkerSize, (b[2] - a[2]) * values.MarkerSize
            local line = lines[i]
            if not line then
                line = make(
                    "Frame",
                    "ShapeEdge" .. i,
                    markerRoot
                )
                ;
                line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                ;
                line.BorderSizePixel = 0
                ;
                line.Active = false
                ;
                lines[i] = line
            end
            line.Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy),
                0,
                2
            )
            line.Position = UDim2.new(
                0.5 + (a[1] + b[1]) / 2,
                0,
                0.5 + (a[2] + b[2]) / 2,
                0
            )
            line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
            ;
            line.BackgroundColor3 = values.Color
        end
        for i = #lines, #vertices + 1, -1 do
            drop(lines[i])
            ;
            lines[i] = nil
        end
    end
    -- Readable local-only replacement, not a decoded copy of the linked obfuscated core.
    -- Ownership records are strong and restore only values still matching our last write.
    local expanded = {
    }
    local expanderFolder
    api.expanderErrors = {
    }
    api.stats.expanded = 0
    api.parts = {
        "Root",
        "Head",
        "Torso",
    }
    local function readPart(part, key)
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return part[key]
        end)
        if ok then
            return value
        end
    end
    local function sameSize(a, b)
        if a == nil or b == nil then
            return false
        end
        local ok, same = pcall(function()
            return (a - b).Magnitude < 0.0001
        end)
        return ok and same
    end
    local function restorePart(part, record)
        if sameSize(readPart(part, "Size"), record.forcedSize) then
            pcall(function()
                part.Size = record.size
            end)
        end
        local current = readPart(part, "CanCollide")
        if record.forcedCollision ~= nil and current == record.forcedCollision and record.collision ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                part.CanCollide = record.collision
            end)
        end
        drop(record.box)
        expanded[part] = nil
    end
    local function restoreExpanded()
        for part, record in pairs(expanded) do
            restorePart(part, record)
        end
        expanded = {
        }
        ;
        drop(expanderFolder)
        ;
        expanderFolder = nil
        api.stats.expanded = 0
        ;
        api.expanderErrors = {
        }
    end
    local function selectedPart(model)
        local part
        if values.ExpanderPart == "Head" then
            part = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        elseif values.ExpanderPart == "Torso" then
