            part = model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        else
            part = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        end
        return part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part or nil
    end
    local function updateExpander()
        if not values.ExpanderEnabled then
            restoreExpanded()
            ;
            return 
        end
        local active = {
        }
        ;
        local count = 0
        api.expanderErrors = {
        }
        for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and not (values.TeamCheck and sameTeam(player)) then
                local model = player.Character
                local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local part = model and model.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and selectedPart(model)
                if part and part.Parent then
                    local original = readPart(part, "Size")
                    if original then
                        local record = expanded[part]
                        if not record then
                            record = {
                                size = original,
                                collision = readPart(part, "CanCollide"),
                            }
                            expanded[part] = record
                        end
                        active[part] = true
                        local size = values.ExpanderSize
                        local wanted = Vector3.new(
                            math.max(record.size.X, size),
                            math.max(record.size.Y, size),
                            math.max(record.size.Z, size)
                        )
                        local ok, reason = pcall(function()
                            if not sameSize(part.Size, wanted) then
                                part.Size = wanted
                            end
                            if part.CanCollide ~= false then
                                part.CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end)
                        if ok then
                            local actualSize = readPart(part, "Size")
                            local actualCollision = readPart(part, "CanCollide")
                            if sameSize(actualSize, wanted) then
                                record.forcedSize = actualSize
                            end
                            if actualCollision == false then
                                record.forcedCollision = false
                            end
                            if not sameSize(actualSize, wanted) or actualCollision ~= false then
                                api.expanderErrors[tostring(player.UserId)] = "Game overrode the local size/collision write"
                            else
                                count = count + 1
                            end
                            if not expanderFolder or not expanderFolder.Parent then
                                drop(expanderFolder)
                                ;
                                expanderFolder = make(
                                    "Folder",
                                    "DEATH_NOTE_LOCAL_EXPANDER",
                                    world
                                )
                            end
                            if not record.box or not record.box.Parent then
                                record.box = make(
                                    "SelectionBox",
                                    "LocalExpandedPartBounds",
                                    expanderFolder
                                )
                                record.box.Adornee = part
                                ;
                                record.box.SurfaceTransparency = 1
                                ;
                                record.box.LineThickness = 0.035
                            end
                            record.box.Color3 = values.Color
                        else
                            api.expanderErrors[tostring(player.UserId)] = tostring(reason):sub(1, 130)
                            -- Retain ownership of any successful first write so OFF can still undo it.
                            local currentSize = readPart(part, "Size")
                            if sameSize(currentSize, wanted) then
                                record.forcedSize = currentSize
                            end
                            if readPart(part, "CanCollide") == false then
                                record.forcedCollision = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for part, record in pairs(expanded) do
            if not active[part] then
                restorePart(part, record)
            end
        end
        api.stats.expanded = count
        if not next(expanded) then
            drop(expanderFolder)
            ;
            expanderFolder = nil
        end
    end
    function api.expanderStatus()
        if not values.ExpanderEnabled then
            return "EXPANDER OFF / ORIGINAL PARTS RESTORED"
        end
        for _, reason in pairs(api.expanderErrors) do
            return "LOCAL WRITE NOTICE: " .. reason
        end
        return tostring(api.stats.expanded or 0) .. " LOCAL PARTS EXPANDED / SERVER HITS NOT GUARANTEED"
    end
    function api.set(id, value)
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Visual overlay closed"
        end
        if id == "Enabled" or id == "MarkerEnabled" or id == "ExpanderEnabled" or id == "TeamCheck" then
            if type(value) ~= "boolean" then
                return false, "Use ON/OFF"
            end
        elseif id == "Style" then
            if value ~= "Outline" and value ~= "Box" and value ~= "Names" then
                return false, "Choose Outline, Box or Names"
            end
        elseif id == "MarkerShape" then
            if value ~= "Square" and value ~= "Circle" and value ~= "Triangle" then
                return false, "Choose Square, Circle or Triangle"
            end
        elseif id == "ExpanderPart" then
            if value ~= "Root" and value ~= "Head" and value ~= "Torso" then
                return false, "Choose Root, Head or Torso"
            end
        elseif id == "ExpanderSize" then
            value = tonumber(value)
            ;
            if not finite(value) then
                return false, "Enter a finite size in studs"
            end
            value = math.clamp(
                value,
                1,
                30
            )
        elseif id == "MarkerSize" then
            value = tonumber(value)
            ;
            if not finite(value) then
                return false, "Enter a finite pixel size"
            end
            value = math.floor(math.clamp(value, 24, 800) + 0.5)
        elseif id == "Color" then
            if typeof(value) ~= "Color3" or not finite(value.R) or not finite(value.G) or not finite(value.B) then
                return false, "Choose a valid color"
            end
            value = Color3.new(
                math.clamp(value.R, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(value.G, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(value.B, 0, 1)
            )
        else
            return false, "Unknown visual option"
        end
        local changed = values[id] ~= value
        if id == "Style" and changed then
            clearESP()
        end
        if id == "ExpanderPart" and changed then
            restoreExpanded()
        end
        values[id] = value
        local ok, reason = pcall(function()
            refreshESP()
            ;
            refreshMarker()
            ;
            updateExpander()
        end)
        api.runtimeWarning = not ok and tostring(reason):sub(1, 160) or nil
        publish()
        return ok, api.runtimeWarning
    end
    connections[#connections + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
        if api.closed or not values.Enabled and not values.MarkerEnabled and not values.ExpanderEnabled then
            return 
        end
        pulse = pulse + math.clamp(
            delta or 0.016,
            0,
            0.25
        )
        if pulse < 0.15 then
            return 
        end
        ;
        pulse = 0
        local ok, reason = pcall(function()
            refreshESP()
            ;
            refreshMarker()
            ;
            updateExpander()
        end)
        api.runtimeWarning = not ok and tostring(reason):sub(1, 160) or nil
    end)
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        api.closed = true
        ;
        values.Enabled = false
        ;
        values.MarkerEnabled = false
        ;
        values.ExpanderEnabled = false
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        clearESP()
        ;
        clearMarker()
        ;
        restoreExpanded()
        ;
        connections = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
    end
    return api
end)()
-- Local camera assistance only. No firing, shot redirection, damage, remotes or hit-rate guarantees.
RedTelemetry.CameraAim = (function()
    local api = {
        closed = false,
        revision = 0,
        targetPlayer = nil,
        targetPart = nil,
        activeMode = nil,
        state = "OFF",
    }
    local values = {
        Enabled = false,
        FOVShape = "Circle",
        Size = 240,
        Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 150),
        AimPart = "Head",
        AssistChance = 100,
        TeamCheck = true,
        WallCheck = true,
        AimStrength = 20,
        AimlockEnabled = false,
        AimlockStrength = 80,
    }
    api.values = values
    ;
    api.shapes = {
        "Circle",
        "Square",
        "Rectangle",
    }
    ;
    api.parts = {
        "Head",
        "Torso",
        "Mix",
    }
    api.fromHSV = RedTelemetry.VisualOverlay.fromHSV
    ;
    api.toHSV = RedTelemetry.VisualOverlay.toHSV
    local players = game:GetService("Players")
    local world = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local guiService
    ;
    pcall(function()
        guiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
    end)
    local connections, listeners, guiConnections = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local held, mix = {
    }, {
    }
    local aimGranted, lockGranted = false, false
    local aimTarget, lockTarget
    local gui, shapeRoot, touchButton
    local edges = {
    }
    local drawnShape, drawnSize, drawnColor
    local windowFocused = true
    local scanElapsed = 1
    local nextListener = 0
    local bindName = "DEATH_NOTE_CAMERA_AIM_V22"
    local bound = false
    local function finite(n)
        return type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn,
        list
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        local bucket = list or connections
        ;
        bucket[#bucket + 1] = c
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function publish()
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[entry[1]] == entry[2] then
                pcall(entry[2])
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if api.closed or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        nextListener = nextListener + 1
        ;
        local id = nextListener
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        local handle = {
            Connected = true,
        }
        function handle:Disconnect()
            self.Connected = false
            ;
            listeners[id] = nil
        end
        return handle
    end
    local function heldNow()
        return next(held) ~= nil
    end
    local function roll()
        if values.AssistChance <= 0 then
            return false
        end
        if values.AssistChance >= 100 then
            return true
        end
        return math.random() * 100 < values.AssistChance
    end
    local function clearTarget()
        aimTarget = nil
        ;
        lockTarget = nil
        ;
        api.targetPlayer = nil
        ;
        api.targetPart = nil
        ;
        api.activeMode = nil
        ;
        scanElapsed = 1
    end
    local function releaseAll()
        held = {
        }
        ;
        aimGranted = false
        ;
        aimTarget = nil
        ;
        api.targetPlayer = nil
        ;
        api.targetPart = nil
        ;
        api.activeMode = nil
    end
    function api.hold(source, down)
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        local was = heldNow()
        if down then
            if not values.Enabled or not windowFocused or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                return false
            end
            held[source] = true
        else
            held[source] = nil
        end
        local active = heldNow()
        if active and not was then
            mix = {
            }
            ;
            aimTarget = nil
            ;
            aimGranted = roll()
            ;
            scanElapsed = 1
        elseif not active then
            aimGranted = false
            ;
            aimTarget = nil
        end
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.contains(dx, dy)
        local half = values.Size / 2
        if values.FOVShape == "Circle" then
            return dx * dx + dy * dy <= half * half
        end
        if values.FOVShape == "Rectangle" then
            return math.abs(dx) <= half and math.abs(dy) <= half * 0.625
        end
        return math.abs(dx) <= half and math.abs(dy) <= half
    end
    function api.alpha(strength, delta)
        local n = math.clamp(
            strength / 100,
            0,
            1
        )
        return 1 - (1 - n) ^ (math.clamp(delta or 1 / 60, 0, 0.1) * 60)
    end
    local function sameTeam(player)
        return LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and player.Team ~= nil and LocalPlayer.Team == player.Team and LocalPlayer.Neutral ~= true and player.Neutral ~= true
    end
    local function torsoOf(model)
        return model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
    end
    local function selectedPart(player)
        local model = player.Character
        ;
        if not model then
            return nil
        end
        local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        ;
        local torso = torsoOf(model)
        local part
        if values.AimPart == "Head" then
            part = head
        elseif values.AimPart == "Torso" then
            part = torso
        else
            local choice = mix[player]
            if not choice or choice.model ~= model then
                choice = {
                    model = model,
                    head = math.random(1, 2) == 1,
                }
                ;
                mix[player] = choice
            end
            part = choice.head and (head or torso) or (torso or head)
        end
        return part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part or nil
    end
    local function lineOfSight(
        camera,
        model,
        part
    )
        if not values.WallCheck then
            return true
        end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        ;
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        ;
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        local ignored = {
        }
        ;
        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            ignored[#ignored + 1] = LocalPlayer.Character
        end
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
        local start = camera.CFrame.Position
        ;
        local direction = part.Position - start
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then
            return true
        end
        local ok, hit = pcall(function()
            return world:Raycast(
                start,
                direction,
                params
            )
        end)
        if not ok then
            return false
        end
        return not hit or hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model) or false
    end
    local function candidate(
        player,
        mode,
        camera
    )
        if player == LocalPlayer or not player.Parent or values.TeamCheck and sameTeam(player) then
            return nil
        end
        local model = player.Character
        local humanoid = model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not model or not model.Parent or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return nil
        end
        local part = selectedPart(player)
        ;
        if not part or not part.Parent then
            return nil
        end
        local delta = part.Position - camera.CFrame.Position
        if delta.Magnitude < 0.001 or delta.Magnitude > 5000 then
            return nil
        end
        local score
        if mode == "Aimbot" then
            local point, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
            if not onScreen or point.Z <= 0 then
                return nil
            end
            local size = camera.ViewportSize
            local dx, dy = point.X - size.X / 2, point.Y - size.Y / 2
            if not api.contains(dx, dy) then
                return nil
            end
            score = dx * dx + dy * dy
        else
            local mine = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            score = (part.Position - (mine and mine.Position or camera.CFrame.Position)).Magnitude
        end
        return {
            player = player,
            model = model,
            part = part,
            score = score,
        }
    end
    function api.findTarget(mode)
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        ;
        if not camera then
            return nil
        end
        local candidates = {
        }
        for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
            local item = candidate(
                player,
                mode,
                camera
            )
            ;
            if item then
                candidates[#candidates + 1] = item
            end
        end
        table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
            if a.score == b.score then
                return a.player.UserId < b.player.UserId
            end
            ;
            return a.score < b.score
        end)
        for _, item in ipairs(candidates) do
            if lineOfSight(camera, item.model, item.part) then
                return item
            end
        end
    end
    local function stillValid(
        item,
        mode,
        camera,
        checkWall
    )
        if not item or item.player.Character ~= item.model or not item.part.Parent then
            return false
        end
        local current = candidate(
            item.player,
            mode,
            camera
        )
        if not current or current.part ~= item.part then
            return false
        end
        return not checkWall or lineOfSight(
            camera,
            item.model,
            item.part
        )
    end
    local function clearGui()
        for _, c in ipairs(guiConnections) do
            c:Disconnect()
        end
        ;
        guiConnections = {
        }
        drop(gui)
        ;
        gui = nil
        ;
        shapeRoot = nil
        ;
        touchButton = nil
        ;
        edges = {
        }
        drawnShape, drawnSize, drawnColor = nil, nil, nil
    end
    local function make(
        class,
        name,
        parent
    )
        local object = Instance.new(class)
        ;
        object.Name = name
        ;
        object.Parent = parent
        ;
        return object
    end
    local function drawFOV()
        if not values.Enabled then
            clearGui()
            ;
            return 
        end
        if not gui or not gui.Parent then
            clearGui()
            gui = make(
                "ScreenGui",
                "DEATH_NOTE_AIM_FOV",
                MainGui.Parent
            )
            gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            ;
            gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            ;
            gui.DisplayOrder = 1
            ;
            gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            shapeRoot = make(
                "Frame",
                "AimFOVShape",
                gui
            )
            shapeRoot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ;
            shapeRoot.Position = UDim2.new(
                0.5,
                0,
                0.5,
                0
            )
            shapeRoot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            ;
            shapeRoot.Active = false
            touchButton = make(
                "TextButton",
                "TouchHoldAim",
                gui
            )
            touchButton.Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                104,
                0,
                43
            )
            ;
            touchButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                1,
                -124,
                1,
                -117
            )
            touchButton.Text = "HOLD AIM"
            ;
            touchButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            ;
            touchButton.TextSize = 13
            touchButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
                22,
                28,
                41
            )
            ;
            touchButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
            ;
            touchButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
            RedUI.Corner(touchButton, 10)
            connect(touchButton.InputBegan, function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                    api.hold(input, true)
                end
            end, guiConnections)
        end
        touchButton.Visible = UserInputService.TouchEnabled == true
        touchButton.TextColor3 = values.Color
        if drawnShape == values.FOVShape and drawnSize == values.Size and drawnColor == values.Color then
            return 
        end
        local points = {
        }
        if values.FOVShape == "Circle" then
            for i = 0, 71 do
                local a = i / 72 * math.pi * 2
                ;
                points[#points + 1] = {
                    math.cos(a) * 0.5,
                    math.sin(a) * 0.5,
                }
            end
        else
            local h = values.FOVShape == "Rectangle" and 0.3125 or 0.5
            points = {
                {
                    -0.5,
                    -h,
                },
                {
                    0.5,
                    -h,
                },
                {
                    0.5,
                    h,
                },
                {
                    -0.5,
                    h,
                },
            }
        end
        shapeRoot.Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            values.Size,
            0,
            values.Size
        )
        for i, a in ipairs(points) do
            local b = points[i % #points + 1]
            ;
            local dx, dy = (b[1] - a[1]) * values.Size, (b[2] - a[2]) * values.Size
            local edge = edges[i]
            if not edge then
                edge = make(
                    "Frame",
                    "AimFOVEdge" .. i,
                    shapeRoot
                )
                ;
                edge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                ;
                edge.BorderSizePixel = 0
                ;
                edge.Active = false
                ;
                edges[i] = edge
            end
            edge.Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy),
                0,
                2
            )
            edge.Position = UDim2.new(
                0.5 + (a[1] + b[1]) / 2,
                0,
                0.5 + (a[2] + b[2]) / 2,
                0
            )
            edge.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
            ;
            edge.BackgroundColor3 = values.Color
        end
        for i = #edges, #points + 1, -1 do
            drop(edges[i])
            ;
            edges[i] = nil
        end
        drawnShape, drawnSize, drawnColor = values.FOVShape, values.Size, values.Color
    end
    function api.status()
        return api.state
    end
    function api.set(id, value)
        if api.closed then
            return false, "Camera assist closed"
        end
        if id == "Enabled" or id == "AimlockEnabled" or id == "TeamCheck" or id == "WallCheck" then
            if type(value) ~= "boolean" then
                return false, "Use ON/OFF"
            end
        elseif id == "FOVShape" then
            if value ~= "Circle" and value ~= "Square" and value ~= "Rectangle" then
                return false, "Choose Circle, Square or Rectangle"
            end
        elseif id == "AimPart" then
            if value ~= "Head" and value ~= "Torso" and value ~= "Mix" then
                return false, "Choose Head, Torso or Mix"
            end
        elseif id == "Size" or id == "AssistChance" or id == "AimStrength" or id == "AimlockStrength" then
            value = tonumber(value)
            ;
            if not finite(value) then
                return false, "Enter a finite number"
            end
            local minimum = id == "Size" and 40 or id == "AssistChance" and 0 or 1
            value = math.floor(math.clamp(value, minimum, id == "Size" and 1000 or 100) + 0.5)
        elseif id == "Color" then
            if typeof(value) ~= "Color3" or not finite(value.R) or not finite(value.G) or not finite(value.B) then
                return false, "Choose a valid colour"
            end
            value = Color3.new(
                math.clamp(value.R, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(value.G, 0, 1),
                math.clamp(value.B, 0, 1)
            )
        else
            return false, "Unknown camera-assist setting"
        end
        local changed = values[id] ~= value
        values[id] = value
        if id == "Enabled" and not value then
            releaseAll()
        end
        if id == "AimlockEnabled" and changed then
            lockGranted = value and roll() or false
            ;
            lockTarget = nil
            ;
            scanElapsed = 1
        end
        if changed and (id == "AimPart" or id == "TeamCheck" or id == "WallCheck" or id == "FOVShape" or id == "Size") then
            mix = {
            }
            ;
            clearTarget()
        end
        if id == "Enabled" and value and changed and UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            api.hold("keyboard", true)
        end
        api.targetPlayer = nil
        ;
        api.targetPart = nil
        ;
        api.activeMode = nil
        if not values.Enabled and not values.AimlockEnabled then
            api.state = "OFF"
        elseif id == "Enabled" and value then
            api.state = "HOLD E / TOUCH TO AIM"
        elseif id == "AimlockEnabled" and value then
            api.state = lockGranted and "AIMLOCK READY" or "AIMLOCK CHANCE SKIPPED"
        end
        local ok, reason = pcall(drawFOV)
        ;
        api.runtimeWarning = not ok and tostring(reason):sub(1, 150) or nil
        publish()
        ;
        return ok, api.runtimeWarning
    end
    local function step(delta)
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        drawFOV()
        if not values.Enabled and not values.AimlockEnabled then
            api.state = "OFF"
            ;
            return 
        end
        local camera = world.CurrentCamera
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not camera or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            clearTarget()
            ;
            releaseAll()
            ;
            api.state = "PAUSED / LOCAL CHARACTER"
            ;
            return 
        end
        if not windowFocused or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or guiService and guiService.MenuIsOpen or camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
            releaseAll()
            ;
            clearTarget()
            ;
            api.state = "PAUSED / INPUT OR CAMERA"
            ;
            return 
        end
        local mode
        if values.Enabled and heldNow() then
            if not aimGranted then
                api.state = "ASSIST CHANCE SKIPPED"
                ;
                api.targetPlayer = nil
                ;
                api.targetPart = nil
                ;
                api.activeMode = nil
                ;
                return 
            end
            mode = "Aimbot"
        elseif values.AimlockEnabled then
            if not lockGranted then
                api.state = "AIMLOCK CHANCE SKIPPED"
                ;
                api.targetPlayer = nil
                ;
                api.targetPart = nil
                ;
                api.activeMode = nil
                ;
                return 
            end
            mode = "Aimlock"
        else
            api.state = "HOLD E / TOUCH TO AIM"
            ;
            api.targetPlayer = nil
            ;
            api.targetPart = nil
            ;
            api.activeMode = nil
            ;
            return 
        end
        scanElapsed = scanElapsed + math.clamp(
            delta or 1 / 60,
            0,
            0.1
        )
        local selected
        if mode == "Aimbot" then
            selected = aimTarget
        else
            selected = lockTarget
        end
        local rescan = scanElapsed >= 0.06
        if selected and not stillValid(selected, mode, camera, true) then
            selected = nil
            ;
            rescan = true
        end
        if rescan then
            scanElapsed = 0
            if mode == "Aimbot" or not selected then
                selected = api.findTarget(mode)
            end
            if mode == "Aimbot" then
                aimTarget = selected
            else
                lockTarget = selected
            end
        end
        if not selected then
            api.state = "NO ELIGIBLE TARGET"
            ;
            api.targetPlayer = nil
            ;
            api.targetPart = nil
            ;
            api.activeMode = nil
            ;
            return 
        end
        local current = camera.CFrame
        local direction = selected.part.Position - current.Position
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then
            return 
        end
        local desired = CFrame.lookAt(current.Position, selected.part.Position)
        local strength = mode == "Aimlock" and values.AimlockStrength or values.AimStrength
        local alpha = api.alpha(strength, delta)
        camera.CFrame = alpha >= 0.999999 and desired or current:Lerp(desired, alpha)
        api.targetPlayer = selected.player
        ;
        api.targetPart = selected.part
        ;
        api.activeMode = mode
        api.state = mode:upper() .. " / " .. selected.player.Name .. " / " .. selected.part.Name
    end
    local function protectedStep(delta)
        local ok, reason = pcall(step, delta)
        api.runtimeWarning = not ok and tostring(reason):sub(1, 160) or nil
        if not ok then
            api.state = "CAMERA ASSIST ERROR"
            ;
            api.targetPlayer = nil
            ;
            api.targetPart = nil
            ;
            api.activeMode = nil
        end
    end
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E and values.Enabled and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            api.hold("keyboard", true)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
            api.hold("keyboard", false)
        end
        if held[input] then
            api.hold(input, false)
        end
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
        windowFocused = false
        ;
        releaseAll()
        ;
        clearTarget()
    end)
    if UserInputService.WindowFocused then
        connect(UserInputService.WindowFocused, function()
            windowFocused = true
        end)
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function()
        releaseAll()
        ;
        clearTarget()
    end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        releaseAll()
        ;
        clearTarget()
    end)
    connect(players.PlayerRemoving, function(player)
        mix[player] = nil
        ;
        if api.targetPlayer == player then
            clearTarget()
        end
    end)
    local ok = pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(
            bindName,
            Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2,
            protectedStep
        )
    end)
    if ok then
        bound = true
    else
        connect(RunService.RenderStepped, protectedStep)
    end
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        api.closed = true
        ;
        values.Enabled = false
        ;
        values.AimlockEnabled = false
        ;
        releaseAll()
        ;
        clearTarget()
        ;
        clearGui()
        if bound then
            pcall(function()
                RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName)
            end)
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
            c:Disconnect()
        end
        connections = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        ;
        mix = {
        }
        ;
        api.state = "CLOSED"
    end
    return api
end)()

    content,
    "VisualsSearch",
    "",
    UDim2.new(0, 166, 0, 25),
    UDim2.new(1, -178, 0, 6)
)
;
search.PlaceholderText = "Search this section..."
local list = scroll(
    content,
    "VisualsSectionList",
    UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -40),
    UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 37)
)
local footer = text(
    root,
    "VisualsFooter",
    "PRESETS: PSHADE ULTIMATE / @IM_PATRICK  |  LOCAL VISUALS ONLY  |  GPU COST VARIES",
    UDim2.new(1, -145, 0, 17),
    UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -18),
    8,
    palette.muted
)
local function cancelDrag()
    if drag then
        drag = nil
        ;
        list.ScrollingEnabled = true
    end
end
local function clearList()
    cancelDrag()
    ;
    refreshers = {
    }
    ;
    presetCards = {
    }
    ;
    cardOrder = 0
    ;
    viewGeneration = viewGeneration + 1
    for _, c in ipairs(viewConnections) do
        c:Disconnect()
    end
    ;
    viewConnections = {
    }
    for _, node in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
        node:Destroy()
    end
    list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
end
local function matches(s)
    local q = search.Text:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    ;
    return q == "" or s:lower(
        ):find(q,
        1,
        true
    )
end
local function pretty(n)
    return (string.format("%.3f", n):gsub("0+$", ""):gsub("%.$", ""))
end
local function card(name, height)
    cardOrder = cardOrder + 1
    ;
    local f = frame(
        list,
        name,
        UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, height),
        nil,
        palette.card
    )
    ;
    f.LayoutOrder = cardOrder
    ;
    round(f, 9)
    ;
    RedUI.Stroke(
        f,
        Color3.fromRGB(48, 55, 79),
        1
    )
    ;
    return f
end
-- Per-field bindings share the controller's current values; text being typed is never polled away.
local function fieldCard(d)
    local available = visual.supported(d) and d.kind ~= "readonly"
    local color = d.kind == "color" and palette.pink or d.kind == "boolean" and palette.cyan or palette.gold
    local height = d.kind == "color" and 128 or d.kind == "vector" and 112 or 103
    if d.help then
        height = height + 24
    end
    if not available then
        height = 92
    end
    local f = card("Setting_" .. d.id, height)
    local label = text(
        f,
        "Label",
        d.label,
        UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 20),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6),
        11,
        available and color or palette.muted
    )
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    text(
        f,
        "Property",
        d.id,
        UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 15),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 27),
        8,
        palette.muted
    )
    if not available then
        local value = d.kind == "readonly" and tostring(visual.values[d.id]) or "UNAVAILABLE ON THIS CLIENT / TERRAIN"
        local disabled = text(
            f,
            "Unavailable",
            value,
            UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 23),
            UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 46),
            10,
            palette.muted
        )
        disabled.TextWrapped = true
        text(
            f,
            "ApplyState",
            d.kind == "readonly" and "READ ONLY / ENGINE CONTROLLED" or "NO SUPPORTED PROPERTY TARGET",
            UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14),
            UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -19),
            8,
            palette.muted
        )
        return 
    end
    local status = text(
        f,
        "ApplyState",
        "",
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 15),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -19),
        8,
        palette.cyan
    )
    local validationError
    local renderers = {
    }
    local context = visual.contextRevision
    local generation = viewGeneration
    local function alive()
        return not visual.closed and generation == viewGeneration and f.Parent == list
    end
    local function render()
        if not alive() then
            return 
        end
        local contextChanged = context ~= visual.contextRevision
        context = visual.contextRevision
        for _, fn in ipairs(renderers) do
            fn(contextChanged)
        end
        status.Text = validationError or visual.status(d.id)
        status.TextColor3 = validationError and palette.pink or visual.enabled and palette.cyan or palette.gold
    end
    local function commit(value, quiet)
        local ok, reason = visual.edit(d.id, value)
        if not ok then
            validationError = reason or "CHANGE REJECTED BY CLIENT"
            if not quiet then
                message(validationError)
            end
        else
            validationError = nil
        end
        render()
        return ok
    end
    -- Every editable box has a protected draft and a context token. Preset/slot/import changes
    -- invalidate old drafts and delayed edits instead of writing yesterday's value back later.
    local function bindEntry(
        box,
        parse,
        format
    )
        local state = {
            editing = false,
            writing = false,
            dirty = false,
            token = 0,
            ignoreBlur = false,
        }
        local function writeCurrent()
            state.writing = true
            box.Text = format(visual.values[d.id])
            state.writing = false
        end
        table.insert(renderers, function(contextChanged)
            if contextChanged then
                state.token = state.token + 1
                state.dirty = false
                state.ignoreBlur = state.editing or box:IsFocused()
                writeCurrent()
            elseif not state.editing and not state.dirty and not box:IsFocused() then
                writeCurrent()
            end
        end)
        on(box.Focused, function()
            state.editing = true
            state.dirty = false
            state.ignoreBlur = false
            state.token = state.token + 1
            validationError = nil
        end)
        on(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
            if state.writing or not alive() then
                return 
            end
            if not state.editing and not box:IsFocused() then
                return 
            end
            state.editing = true
            state.dirty = true
            state.ignoreBlur = false
            state.token = state.token + 1
            local token = state.token
            local editContext = visual.contextRevision
            validationError = nil
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if not alive() or state.token ~= token or visual.contextRevision ~= editContext then
                    return 
                end
                if not state.editing or not state.dirty then
                    return 
                end
                local value = parse(box.Text)
                if value ~= nil then
                    commit(value, true)
                end
            end)
        end)
        on(box.FocusLost, function()
            -- Capture the draft before publishing can refresh the text box.
            local raw = box.Text
            local ignore = state.ignoreBlur
            state.token = state.token + 1
            state.editing = false
            state.dirty = false
            state.ignoreBlur = false
            if not alive() then
                return 
            end
            if not ignore then
                local value, reason = parse(raw)
                if value == nil then
                    validationError = reason or "INVALID INPUT / PREVIOUS VALUE KEPT"
                    message(validationError)
                else
                    commit(value, false)
                end
            end
            writeCurrent()
            render()
        end)
        writeCurrent()
    end
    if d.kind == "boolean" then
        local b = button(f, "Toggle_" .. d.id, "", UDim2.new(0, 77, 0, 27), UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 45), function()
            commit(not visual.values[d.id])
        end)
        text(
            f,
            "StateMeaning",
            "SYNCED WITH CURRENT LOOK",
            UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 24),
            UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 46),
            8,
            palette.muted
        )
        table.insert(renderers, function()
            local value = visual.values[d.id]
            b.Text = value and "ON" or "OFF"
            b.BackgroundColor3 = value and Color3.fromRGB(28, 107, 116) or palette.field
        end)
    elseif d.kind == "number" then
        local box = input(
            f,
            "Value_" .. d.id,
            "",
            UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 27),
            UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, 45)
        )
        bindEntry(box, function(raw)
            return visual.validate(d.id, raw)
        end, pretty)
        button(f, "Minus_" .. d.id, "-", UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 27), UDim2.new(1, -144, 0, 45), function()
            commit(visual.values[d.id] - d.step)
        end)
        button(f, "Plus_" .. d.id, "+", UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 27), UDim2.new(1, -115, 0, 45), function()
            commit(visual.values[d.id] + d.step)
        end)
        local bar = frame(
            f,
            "Slider_" .. d.id,
            UDim2.new(1, -168, 0, 24),
            UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 47),
            palette.field
        )
        round(bar, 7)
        local fill = frame(
            bar,
            "Fill",
            UDim2.new(),
            nil,
            Color3.fromRGB(78, 149, 175)
        )
        round(fill, 7)
        local function slide(x)
            local a = math.clamp(
                (x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, bar.AbsoluteSize.X),
                0,
                1
            )
            commit(math.floor((d.min + (d.max - d.min) * a) / d.step + 0.5) * d.step, true)
        end
        bar.Active = true
        on(bar.InputBegan, function(inputEvent)
            if inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                local focused = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
                if focused then
                    focused:ReleaseFocus()
                end
                drag = {
                    input = inputEvent,
                    slide = slide,
                }
                list.ScrollingEnabled = false
                slide(inputEvent.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        table.insert(renderers, function()
            local a = math.clamp(
                (visual.values[d.id] - d.min) / (d.max - d.min),
                0,
                1
            )
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(
                a,
                0,
                1,
                0
            )
        end)
    elseif d.kind == "color" then
        local swatch = frame(
            f,
            "Swatch",
            UDim2.new(0, 29, 0, 29),
            UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 49),
            visual.values[d.id]
        )
        round(swatch, 6)
        local hex = input(
            f,
            "Hex_" .. d.id,
            "",
            UDim2.new(0, 75, 0, 27),
            UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 50)
        )
        bindEntry(hex, function(raw)
            local value = raw:gsub("#", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            if #value ~= 6 or not value:match("^%x+$") then
                return nil, "USE SIX HEX DIGITS, e.g. #A8C9FF"
            end
            return Color3.fromRGB(
                tonumber(value:sub(1, 2), 16),
                tonumber(value:sub(3, 4), 16),
                tonumber(value:sub(5, 6), 16)
            )
        end, function(value)
            return string.format(
                "#%02X%02X%02X",
                math.floor(value.R * 255 + 0.5),
                math.floor(value.G * 255 + 0.5),
                math.floor(value.B * 255 + 0.5)
            )
        end)
        for i, channel in ipairs({
            "R",
            "G",
            "B",
        }) do
            local component = i
            local x = 128 + (i - 1) * 47
            text(
                f,
                channel .. "Label",
                channel,
                UDim2.new(0, 41, 0, 12),
                UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 40),
                8,
                palette.muted
            )
            local box = input(
                f,
                channel .. "_" .. d.id,
                "",
                UDim2.new(0, 41, 0, 27),
                UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 54)
            )
            bindEntry(box, function(raw)
                local number = tonumber(raw)
                if not number or number ~= number or math.abs(number) == math.huge then
                    return nil, "RGB REQUIRES A FINITE NUMBER"
                end
                local value = visual.values[d.id]
                local rgb = {
                    value.R * 255,
                    value.G * 255,
                    value.B * 255,
                }
                rgb[component] = math.clamp(
                    number,
                    0,
                    255
                )
                return Color3.fromRGB(
                    rgb[1],
                    rgb[2],
                    rgb[3]
                )
            end, function(value)
                local rgb = {
                    value.R,
                    value.G,
                    value.B,
                }
                return tostring(math.floor(rgb[component] * 255 + 0.5))
            end)
        end
        table.insert(renderers, function()
            swatch.BackgroundColor3 = visual.values[d.id]
        end)
    elseif d.kind == "vector" then
        for i, axis in ipairs({
            "X",
            "Y",
            "Z",
        }) do
            local component = i
            local box = input(
                f,
                axis .. "_" .. d.id,
                "",
                UDim2.new(0.31, -6, 0, 27),
                UDim2.new((i - 1) * 0.32, 10, 0, 48)
            )
            bindEntry(box, function(raw)
                local number = tonumber(raw)
                if not number or number ~= number or math.abs(number) == math.huge then
                    return nil, "XYZ REQUIRES A FINITE NUMBER"
                end
                local value = visual.values[d.id]
                local xyz = {
                    value.X,
                    value.Y,
                    value.Z,
                }
                xyz[component] = number
                return Vector3.new(
                    xyz[1],
                    xyz[2],
                    xyz[3]
                )
            end, function(value)
                return pretty(({
                    value.X,
                    value.Y,
                    value.Z,
                })[component])
            end)
        end
    elseif d.kind == "asset" then
        local box = input(
            f,
            "Asset_" .. d.id,
            "",
            UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 27),
            UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 46)
        )
        bindEntry(box, function(raw)
            return visual.validate(d.id, raw)
        end, tostring)
    end
    if d.help then
        local hint = text(
            f,
            "Hint",
            d.help,
            UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20),
            UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -43),
            8,
            palette.muted
        )
        hint.TextWrapped = true
    end
    table.insert(refreshers, render)
    render()
end
local function infoCard(
    name,
    title,
    body,
    height
)
    local f = card(name, height or 115)
    text(f, "Title", title, UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), 11, palette.cyan).Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    local details = text(
        f,
        "Details",
        body,
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -38),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 31),
        9,
        palette.muted
    )
    details.TextWrapped = true
    ;
    details.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    return f
end
local function diagnosticPanel()
    infoCard(
        "VisualDiagnosticsIntro",
        "REAL PROPERTY READBACK / NO FALSE RENDER CLAIMS",
        "This report compares requested values with actual local properties. A matched property does not prove GPU rendering: shadows, depth of field, bloom, native Terrain water, streaming and asset permissions have scene/engine requirements.",
        124
    )
    local f = card("VisualDiagnosticActions", 42)
    local reportBox
    button(f, "RefreshVisualDiagnostics", "REFRESH REPORT", UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6), function()
        reportBox.Text = visual.report()
    end)
    button(f, "CopyVisualDiagnostics", "COPY REPORT", UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0, 28), UDim2.new(0.5, 6, 0, 6), function()
        if RedEnv.SetClipboard(reportBox.Text) then
            message("Diagnostic report copied")
        else
            message("Clipboard unavailable; copy the text manually")
        end
    end)
    local body = card("VisualDiagnosticReport", 410)
    reportBox = input(
        body,
        "VisualDiagnosticText",
        visual.report(),
        UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16),
        UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
    )
    reportBox.MultiLine = true
    ;
    reportBox.TextWrapped = true
    ;
    reportBox.TextSize = 9
    ;
    reportBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    ;
    reportBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
end
local function drawESP()
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 9)
    ;
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    ;
    layout.Parent = list
    local generation = viewGeneration
    local renderers = {
    }
    local function alive()
        return generation == viewGeneration and not esp.closed
    end
    local function commit(id, value)
        local ok, why = esp.set(id, value)
        if not ok then
            message(why or "Visual change unavailable")
        end
        return ok
    end
    local function bindBox(
        box,
        parse,
        format
    )
        local editing, writing, token = false, false, 0
        local function write()
            writing = true
            ;
            box.Text = format()
            ;
            writing = false
        end
        table.insert(renderers, function()
            if not editing and not box:IsFocused() then
                write()
            end
        end)
        on(box.Focused, function()
            editing = true
            ;
            token = token + 1
        end)
        on(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
            if writing or not alive() or not editing and not box:IsFocused() then
                return 
            end
            editing = true
            ;
            token = token + 1
            ;
            local pending = token
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if not alive() or token ~= pending then
                    return 
                end
                local id, value = parse(box.Text)
                if id then
                    commit(id, value)
                end
            end)
        end)
        on(box.FocusLost, function()
            local raw = box.Text
            ;
            token = token + 1
            ;
            editing = false
            if not alive() then
                return 
            end
            local id, value = parse(raw)
            if id then
                commit(id, value)
            else
                message(value or "Invalid input; previous value kept")
            end
            write()
        end)
        write()
    end
    local switch = card("SimpleESPControl", 65)
    text(switch, "Title", "ESP", UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 24), UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8), 15, palette.white).Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    text(
        switch,
        "Hint",
        "Turn ON to choose an ESP type",
        UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 17),
        UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 35),
        9,
        palette.muted
    )
    local toggle = button(switch, "SimpleESPToggle", "", UDim2.new(0, 106, 0, 31), UDim2.new(1, -118, 0, 15), function()
        commit("Enabled", not esp.values.Enabled)
    end)
    local typeCard = card("SimpleESPTypes", 81)
    text(
        typeCard,
        "Title",
        "CHOOSE ESP TYPE",
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 21),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7),
        11,
        palette.cyan
    )
    local typeButtons = {
    }
    for i, name in ipairs(esp.styles) do
        local style = name
        local caption = style == "Names" and "NAME + HEALTH" or style:upper()
        typeButtons[style] = button(typeCard, "ESPType_" .. style, caption, UDim2.new(0.32, -6, 0, 29), UDim2.new((i - 1) * 0.33, 8, 0, 36), function()
            commit("Style", style)
        end)
    end
    table.insert(renderers, function()
        toggle.Text = esp.values.Enabled and "ESP ON" or "ESP OFF"
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = esp.values.Enabled and Color3.fromRGB(35, 107, 116) or palette.field
        typeCard.Visible = esp.values.Enabled
        typeCard.Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -4,
            0,
            esp.values.Enabled and 81 or 0
        )
        for name, b in pairs(typeButtons) do
            b.BackgroundColor3 = esp.values.Style == name and Color3.fromRGB(135, 54, 104) or palette.field
        end
    end)
    -- Full HSV square with independent hue rail, plus HEX and RGB inputs.
    local picker = card("SimpleESPColorPicker", 239)
    text(picker, "Title", "ESP COLOUR", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 23), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7), 13, palette.white).Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    local sv = frame(
        picker,
        "ColorSVSquare",
        UDim2.new(0.64, -18, 0, 144),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 42),
        Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    )
    ;
    sv.Active = true
    ;
    sv.ClipsDescendants = true
    local saturation = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    ;
    saturation.Parent = sv
    local shade = frame(
        sv,
        "ValueShade",
        UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        UDim2.new(),
        Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    )
    ;
    shade.Active = true
    local valueGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    valueGradient.Rotation = 90
    valueGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
    })
    valueGradient.Parent = shade
    local cursor = frame(
        sv,
        "ColorSVCursor",
        UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9),
        UDim2.new(),
        Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    )
    ;
    round(cursor, 9)
    ;
    RedUI.Stroke(
        cursor,
        Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        1
    )
    cursor.Active = false
    local hue = frame(
        picker,
        "ColorHueRail",
        UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 144),
        UDim2.new(0.64, -2, 0, 42),
        Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    )
    ;
    hue.Active = true
    local rainbow = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    ;
    rainbow.Rotation = 90
    local keys = {
    }
    for i = 0, 6 do
        keys[#keys + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, esp.fromHSV(i / 6, 1, 1))
    end
    rainbow.Color = ColorSequence.new(keys)
    ;
    rainbow.Parent = hue
    local hueCursor = frame(
        hue,
        "ColorHueCursor",
        UDim2.new(1, 4, 0, 4),
        UDim2.new(0, -2, 0, 0),
        Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    )
    ;
    RedUI.Stroke(
        hueCursor,
        Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
        1
    )
    local swatch = frame(
        picker,
        "ColorPreview",
        UDim2.new(0, 27, 0, 27),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 197),
        esp.values.Color
    )
    ;
    round(swatch, 5)
    local readout = text(
        picker,
        "ColorReadout",
        "",
        UDim2.new(1, -61, 0, 26),
        UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 197),
        9,
        palette.muted
    )
    local hex = input(
        picker,
        "SimpleESPColorHex",
        "",
        UDim2.new(0.28, -10, 0, 27),
        UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 42)
    )
    local function colorHex(c)
        return string.format(
            "#%02X%02X%02X",
            math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
        )
    end
    bindBox(hex, function(raw)
        local s = raw:gsub("#", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if #s ~= 6 or not s:match("^%x+$") then
            return nil, "Enter six HEX digits, e.g. #55CCFF"
        end
        return "Color", Color3.fromRGB(
            tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16),
            tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16),
            tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16)
        )
    end, function()
        return colorHex(esp.values.Color)

    local function colorRefresh()
        local c = esp.values.Color
        if c ~= lastColor then
            local nh, ns, nv = esp.toHSV(c)
            if nv > 1e-06 then
                s = ns
                ;
                if ns > 1e-06 then
                    h = nh
                end
            end
            v = nv
            ;
            lastColor = c
        end
        saturation.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), esp.fromHSV(h, 1, 1))
        cursor.Position = UDim2.new(
            s,

                ;

                    focused:ReleaseFocus()
                end
                drag = {
                    input = inputEvent,
                    slide = slide,
                }
                ;
                list.ScrollingEnabled = false
                slide(inputEvent.Position.X, inputEvent.Position.Y)
            end
        end)
    end

local function drawAim()
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 9)
    ;
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    ;
    layout.Parent = list
    local generation = viewGeneration
    local renderers = {
    }
    local function alive()
        return generation == viewGeneration and not aim.closed
    end
    local function commit(id, value)
        local ok, why = aim.set(id, value)
        if not ok then
            message(why or "Camera assist change unavailable")
        end
        return ok
    end
    local function bindBox(
        box,
        parse,
        format
    )
        local editing, writing, token = false, false, 0
        local function write()
            writing = true
            ;
            box.Text = format()
            ;
            writing = false
        end
        table.insert(renderers, function()
            if not editing and not box:IsFocused() then
                write()
            end
        end)
        on(box.Focused, function()
            editing = true
            ;
            token = token + 1
        end)
        on(box:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
            if writing or not alive() or not editing and not box:IsFocused() then
                return 
            end
            editing = true
            ;
            token = token + 1
            ;
            local pending = token
            task.delay(0.12, function()
                if not alive() or token ~= pending then
                    return 
                end
                local id, value = parse(box.Text)
                if id then
                    commit(id, value)
                end
            end)
        end)
        on(box.FocusLost, function()
            local raw = box.Text
            ;
            token = token + 1
            ;
            editing = false
            if not alive() then
                return 
            end
            local id, value = parse(raw)
            if id then
                commit(id, value)
            else
                message(value or "Invalid input; previous value kept")
            end
            write()
        end)
        write()
    end
    local main = card("AimbotControl", 82)
    text(main, "Title", "AIMBOT / CAMERA ASSIST", UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 23), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8), 13, palette.white).Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    local enabled = button(main, "AimbotToggle", "", UDim2.new(0, 118, 0, 29), UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 7), function()
        commit("Enabled", not aim.values.Enabled)
    end)
    local activity = text(
        main,
        "Activity",
        "",
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 18),

        9,
        palette.cyan
    )
    text(

        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 19),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 59),
        8,
        palette.muted
    )
    local choices = card("AimFOVChoices", 80)
    text(

    }

        shapeButtons[shape] = button(choices, "AimShape_" .. shape, shape:upper(), UDim2.new(0.32, -6, 0, 29), UDim2.new((i - 1) * 0.33, 8, 0, 36), function()
            commit("FOVShape", shape)
        end)
    end
    table.insert(renderers, function()
        enabled.Text = aim.values.Enabled and "AIMBOT ON" or "AIMBOT OFF"

    local startPicker
    local function numberControl(
        name,
        label,
        id,
        minimum,
        maximum,
        step,
        help
    )
        local f = card(name, 113)

        local box = input(

            if not n or n ~= n or math.abs(n) == math.huge then
                return nil, "Enter a finite number"

        end, function()
            return pretty(aim.values[id])
        end)
        local bar = frame(
            f,

                1,
                0

    -- Full HSV square with independent hue rail, plus HEX and RGB inputs.
    local picker = card("AimColourPicker", 239)
    text(picker, "Title", "AIM FOV COLOUR", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 23), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7), 13, palette.white).Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    local sv = frame(

    local cursor = frame(

        UDim2.new(0.64, -2, 0, 42),

    hue.Active = true

    ;

    local keys = {
    }
    for i = 0, 6 do
        keys[#keys + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(i / 6, aim.fromHSV(i / 6, 1, 1))
    end
    rainbow.Color = ColorSequence.new(keys)
    ;
    rainbow.Parent = hue
    local hueCursor = frame(
        hue,

    RedUI.Stroke(

        1
    )
    local swatch = frame(
        picker,
        "AimColorPreview",
        UDim2.new(0, 27, 0, 27),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 197),
        aim.values.Color
    )
    ;
    round(swatch, 5)
    local readout = text(
        picker,
        "AimColorReadout",
        "",
        UDim2.new(1, -61, 0, 26),

        palette.muted
    )
    local hex = input(
        picker,
        "AimColorHex",
        "",
        UDim2.new(0.28, -10, 0, 27),
        UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 42)
    )
    local function colorHex(c)
        return string.format(
            "#%02X%02X%02X",
            math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
        )
    end
    bindBox(hex, function(raw)
        local s = raw:gsub("#", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if #s ~= 6 or not s:match("^%x+$") then
            return nil, "Enter six HEX digits, e.g. #55CCFF"
        end
        return "Color", Color3.fromRGB(
            tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16),
            tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16),
            tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16)
        )
    end, function()
        return colorHex(aim.values.Color)
    end)
    for i, channel in ipairs({
        "R",
        "G",
        "B",
    }) do
        local component = i
        text(
            picker,
            channel .. "Label",
            channel,
            UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 24),
            UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 72 + (i - 1) * 35),
            9,
            palette.muted
        )
        local box = input(
            picker,
            "AimColor" .. channel,
            "",
            UDim2.new(0.28, -30, 0, 26),
            UDim2.new(0.72, 20, 0, 72 + (i - 1) * 35)
        )
        bindBox(box, function(raw)
            local n = tonumber(raw)
            if not n or n ~= n or math.abs(n) == math.huge then
                return nil, "Enter an RGB number from 0 to 255"
            end
            local c = aim.values.Color
            ;
            local rgb = {
                c.R * 255,
                c.G * 255,
                c.B * 255,
            }
            ;

                n,

                rgb[1],
                rgb[2],
                rgb[3]
            )
        end, function()
            local c = aim.values.Color

            return tostring(math.floor(({
                c.R,
                c.G,
                c.B,
            })[component] * 255 + 0.5))
        end)

    local h, s, v = aim.toHSV(aim.values.Color)
    local lastColor
    local function colorRefresh()
        local c = aim.values.Color
        if c ~= lastColor then
            local nh, ns, nv = aim.toHSV(c)
            if nv > 1e-06 then
                s = ns
                ;
                if ns > 1e-06 then
                    h = nh
                end
            end
            v = nv
            ;
            lastColor = c
        end
        saturation.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), aim.fromHSV(h, 1, 1))
        cursor.Position = UDim2.new(
            s,
            -4,
            1 - v,
            -4
        )
        hueCursor.Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            -2,
            h,
            -2
        )
        swatch.BackgroundColor3 = c
        readout.Text = colorHex(c) .. "  /  FOV outline only / independent of ESP"
    end
    table.insert(renderers, colorRefresh)
    local function pickSV(x, y)
        s = math.clamp(
            (x - sv.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, sv.AbsoluteSize.X),
            0,
            1
        )
        v = 1 - math.clamp(
            (y - sv.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, sv.AbsoluteSize.Y),
            0,
            1
        )
        commit("Color", aim.fromHSV(h, s, v))
        ;
        colorRefresh()
    end
    local function pickHue(_, y)
        h = math.clamp(
            (y - hue.AbsolutePosition.Y) / math.max(1, hue.AbsoluteSize.Y),
            0,
            1
        )
        commit("Color", aim.fromHSV(h, s, v))
        ;
        colorRefresh()
    end
    startPicker = function(signal, slide)
        on(signal, function(inputEvent)
            if inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                local focused = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
                ;
                if focused then
                    focused:ReleaseFocus()
                end
                drag = {
                    input = inputEvent,
                    slide = slide,
                }
                ;
                list.ScrollingEnabled = false
                slide(inputEvent.Position.X, inputEvent.Position.Y)
            end
        end)
    end
    startPicker(sv.InputBegan, pickSV)
    ;
    startPicker(shade.InputBegan, pickSV)
    ;
    startPicker(cursor.InputBegan, pickSV)
    ;
    startPicker(hue.InputBegan, pickHue)
    ;
    startPicker(hueCursor.InputBegan, pickHue)
    numberControl(
        "AimSize",
        "FOV SIZE / PIXELS",
        "Size",
        40,
        1000,
        1,
        "Circle diameter / Square side / Rectangle width. Rectangle height is 62.5% of its width. Selection and outline use the same screen centre."
    )
    local sizeCard = list:FindFirstChild("AimSize")
    sizeCard.LayoutOrder = choices.LayoutOrder + 1
    picker.LayoutOrder = sizeCard.LayoutOrder + 1
    table.insert(renderers, function()
        sizeCard.Visible = aim.values.Enabled
        ;
        sizeCard.Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -4,
            0,
            aim.values.Enabled and 113 or 0
        )
        picker.Visible = aim.values.Enabled
        ;
        picker.Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -4,
            0,
            aim.values.Enabled and 239 or 0
        )
    end)
    local body = card("AimBodyPart", 83)
    text(
        body,
        "Title",
        "TARGET BODY PART",
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7),
        11,
        palette.cyan
    )
    local partButtons = {
    }
    for i, name in ipairs(aim.parts) do
        local part = name
        partButtons[part] = button(body, "AimPart_" .. part, part:upper(), UDim2.new(0.32, -6, 0, 29), UDim2.new((i - 1) * 0.33, 8, 0, 37), function()
            commit("AimPart", part)
        end)
    end
    table.insert(renderers, function()
        for name, b in pairs(partButtons) do
            b.BackgroundColor3 = aim.values.AimPart == name and Color3.fromRGB(135, 54, 104) or palette.field
        end
    end)
    numberControl(
        "AimChance",
        "AIM-ASSIST CHANCE / %",
        "AssistChance",
        0,
        100,
        1,
        "One chance roll per new E/touch hold or Aimlock ON activation. Changes apply on the next activation. This is NOT bullet-hit percentage."
    )
    local checks = card("AimChecks", 101)
    text(
        checks,
        "Title",
        "TARGET CHECKS / SHARED WITH AIMLOCK",
        UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22),
        UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 7),

        palette.cyan
    )
    local team = button(checks, "AimTeamCheck", "", UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 29), UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 38), function()
        commit("TeamCheck", not aim.values.TeamCheck)
    end)
    local wall = button(checks, "AimWallCheck", "", UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0, 29), UDim2.new(0.5, 5, 0, 38), function()
        commit("WallCheck", not aim.values.WallCheck)
    end)
    text(checks, "Hint", "Native Roblox Teams + local line-of-sight raycast. Custom factions and server penetration rules are not inferred.", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 73), 8, palette.muted).TextWrapped = true
    table.insert(renderers, function()
        team.Text = aim.values.TeamCheck and "TEAM CHECK ON" or "TEAM CHECK OFF"
        wall.Text = aim.values.WallCheck and "WALL CHECK ON" or "WALL CHECK OFF"
        team.BackgroundColor3 = aim.values.TeamCheck and Color3.fromRGB(35, 107, 116) or palette.field
        wall.BackgroundColor3 = aim.values.WallCheck and Color3.fromRGB(35, 107, 116) or palette.field
    end)
    local lock = card("AimlockControl", 99)
    text(lock, "Title", "AIMLOCK", UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 23), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 9), 14, palette.white).Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    local lockToggle = button(lock, "AimlockToggle", "", UDim2.new(0, 118, 0, 29), UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 8), function()
        commit("AimlockEnabled", not aim.values.AimlockEnabled)
    end)
    text(lock, "Hint", "ON acquires the closest eligible opponent in world distance, then tracks it until invalid. Independent of E hold and FOV. Team/Wall Check still apply.", UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 47), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45), 9, palette.muted).TextWrapped = true
    table.insert(renderers, function()
        lockToggle.Text = aim.values.AimlockEnabled and "AIMLOCK ON" or "AIMLOCK OFF"

        1,

    )
    local function refresh()
        if alive() then
            for _, fn in ipairs(renderers) do
                fn()
            end
        end
    end
    table.insert(refreshers, refresh)
