-- Death'Note R15 emotes. Catalog-only adaptation of the user-supplied source.
-- No remote Lua, Roblox wheel/Chat hooks, Animate edits, locomotion overrides or freeze mode.
RedTelemetry.Emotes = (function()
    local api = {
        closed = false,
        enabled = false,
        browserOpen = false,
        ready = false,
        loading = false,
        loaded = 0,
        total = EmoteCatalogData.total,
        page = 1,
        pageSize = 12,
        pages = 1,
        query = "",
        favoritesOnly = false,
        thumbnails = false,
        filtering = false,
        filterProgress = 0,
        resultRevision = 0,
        revision = 0,
        state = "R15 TOOL OFF",
        error = nil,
        nowPlaying = nil,
        nowId = nil,
        progress = "CATALOG NOT LOADED",
        favoriteCount = 0,
    }
    local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local items, byId, results, favorites = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local connections, toolConnections, listeners = {
    }, {
    }, {
    }
    local tool, ownedTrack, ownedAnimation, pending, inflight, ownedCharacter, ownedHum
    local requestGeneration = 0
    local nativeBusy = false
    local queryGeneration = 0
    local queryJob
    local queryDue
    local clock = 0
    local maintenance = 0
    local loadIndex = 1
    local chunkCount = #EmoteCatalogData.chunks
    local listenerId = 0
    local lastSignature = ""
    local lastClick = -100
    local favoriteDirty = false
    local favoriteDue = 0
    local favoritesLoaded = false
    local favoritesPath = "DeathNote/Emotes.Favorites.v26.json"
    local removing
    local function connect(
        signal,
        fn,
        bucket
    )
        local c = signal:Connect(fn)
        ;
        table.insert(
            bucket or connections,
            c
        )
        ;
        return c
    end
    local function drop(object)
        if object then
            pcall(function()
                object:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function disconnect(list)
        for _, c in ipairs(list) do
            c:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    local function publish(force)
        local signature = table.concat({
            tostring(api.enabled),
            tostring(api.browserOpen),
            tostring(api.ready),
            tostring(api.loaded),
            tostring(api.page),
            tostring(api.resultRevision),
            tostring(api.filtering),
            tostring(api.filterProgress),
            api.query,
            tostring(api.favoritesOnly),
            tostring(api.thumbnails),
            tostring(api.favoriteCount),
            api.state,
            api.error or "",
            api.progress,
            api.nowId or "",
        }, "|")
        if not force and signature == lastSignature then
            return 
        end
        lastSignature = signature
        ;
        api.revision = api.revision + 1
        local batch = {
        }
        ;
        for id, fn in pairs(listeners) do
            batch[#batch + 1] = {
                id,
                fn,
            }
        end
        for _, pair in ipairs(batch) do
            if listeners[pair[1]] == pair[2] then
                pcall(pair[2])
            end
        end
    end
    function api.subscribe(fn)
        if api.closed or type(fn) ~= "function" then
            return {
                Disconnect = function()

                end,
            }
        end
        listenerId = listenerId + 1
        ;
        local id = listenerId
        ;
        listeners[id] = fn
        local handle = {
            Connected = true,
        }
        function handle:Disconnect()
            self.Connected = false
            ;
            listeners[id] = nil
        end
        return handle
    end
    local function characterInfo()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character == removing then
            character = nil
        end
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        return character, hum, animator
    end
    local function moving(hum)
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.PlatformStand or hum.Sit then
            return true
        end
        if hum.MoveDirection and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.03 then
            return true
        end
        local ok, state = pcall(function()
            return hum:GetState()
        end)
        if not ok then
            return true
        end
        return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    end
    local function disposeTrack(
        track,
        animation
    )
        if track then
            pcall(function()
                track:Stop(0.12)
            end)
            ;
            drop(track)
        end
        drop(animation)
    end
    function api.stop(reason)
        requestGeneration = requestGeneration + 1
        ;
        inflight = nil
        ;
        ownedCharacter = nil
        ;
        ownedHum = nil
        if pending then
            disposeTrack(
                pending.track,
                pending.animation
            )
            ;
            pending = nil
        end
        disposeTrack(
            ownedTrack,
            ownedAnimation
        )
        ;
        ownedTrack = nil
        ;
        ownedAnimation = nil
        api.nowPlaying = nil
        ;
        api.nowId = nil
        if reason then
            api.state = reason
        end
        publish()
    end
    local function stow()
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if tool and tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character and backpack then
            pcall(function()
                tool.Parent = backpack
            end)
        end
    end
    local function loadFavorites()
        if favoritesLoaded then
            return 
        end
        favoritesLoaded = true
        if type(isfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" then
            return 
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            if not isfile(favoritesPath) then
                return nil
            end
            local raw = readfile(favoritesPath)
            if type(raw) ~= "string" or #raw > 2000000 then
                return nil
            end
            return http:JSONDecode(raw)
        end)
        if ok and type(data) == "table" then
            for _, id in ipairs(data) do
                id = tostring(id)
                ;
                if id:match("^%d+$") and #id <= 16 then
                    favorites[id] = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function saveFavorites()
        if not favoriteDirty then
            return 
        end
        favoriteDirty = false
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return 
        end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder) == "function" and type(makefolder) == "function" and not isfolder("DeathNote") then
                makefolder("DeathNote")
            end
            local saved = {
            }
            ;
            for id in pairs(favorites) do
                saved[#saved + 1] = id
            end
            writefile(
                favoritesPath,
                http:JSONEncode(saved)
            )
        end)
        if not ok then
            api.error = "Favorites kept in memory; local file save unavailable"
        end
    end
    local function favoriteCount()
        local n = 0
        ;
        for id in pairs(favorites) do
            if byId[id] then
                n = n + 1
            end
        end
        ;
        api.favoriteCount = n
    end
    local function updatePages()
        api.pages = math.max(
            1,
            math.ceil(#results / api.pageSize)
        )
        ;
        api.page = math.clamp(
            api.page,
            1,
            api.pages
        )
        api.resultRevision = api.resultRevision + 1
    end
    local function startQuery()
        if not api.ready then
            return 
        end
        queryGeneration = queryGeneration + 1
        local words = {
        }
        for word in api.query:lower():gmatch("%S+") do
            if #words < 8 then
                words[#words + 1] = word
            end
        end
        if #words == 0 and not api.favoritesOnly then
            results = items
            ;
            queryJob = nil
            ;
            api.filtering = false
            ;
            api.filterProgress = 100
            ;
            api.page = 1
            ;
            updatePages()
            ;
            return 
        end
        queryJob = {
            generation = queryGeneration,
            index = 1,
            result = {
            },
            words = words,
            favorites = api.favoritesOnly,
        }
        api.filtering = true
        ;
        api.filterProgress = 0
    end
    function api.search(query)
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        local value = tostring(query or "")
        local valid, cut = pcall(function()
            return utf8.offset(
                value,
                101
            )
        end)
        if valid then
            if cut then
                value = value:sub(
                    1,
                    cut - 1
                )
            end
        else
            value = value:gsub(
                "[\128-\255]",
                ""):sub(1,
                100
            )
        end
        api.query = value
        queryGeneration = queryGeneration + 1
        ;
        queryJob = nil
        ;
        queryDue = clock + 0.18
        api.filtering = api.ready
        ;
        api.filterProgress = 0
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.toggleFavoritesOnly()
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        api.favoritesOnly = not api.favoritesOnly
        ;
        queryDue = nil
        ;
        startQuery()
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.favorite(id)
        id = tostring(id)
        ;
        return favorites[id] == true
    end
    function api.toggleFavorite(id)
        id = tostring(id)
        if not byId[id] or api.closed then
            return false
        end
        if favorites[id] then
            favorites[id] = nil
        else
            favorites[id] = true
        end
        favoriteCount()
        ;
        favoriteDirty = true
        ;
        favoriteDue = clock + 0.5
        if api.favoritesOnly then
            startQuery()
        end
        api.resultRevision = api.resultRevision + 1
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.setThumbnails(value)
        if api.closed or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false
        end
        api.thumbnails = value
        ;
        api.resultRevision = api.resultRevision + 1
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.goToPage(number)
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        number = tonumber(number)
        if not number or number ~= number or math.abs(number) == math.huge then
            return false
        end
        api.page = math.clamp(
            math.floor(number),
            1,
            api.pages
        )
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    function api.pageItems()
        local page = {
        }
        local start = (api.page - 1) * api.pageSize + 1
        for i = start, math.min(#results, start + api.pageSize - 1) do
            page[#page + 1] = results[i]
        end
        return page, #results
    end
    function api.load()
        if api.closed then
            return false
        end
        if api.ready then
            return true
        end
        api.loading = true
        ;
        api.error = nil
        ;
        api.progress = "LOADING EMBEDDED CATALOG / 500 ITEMS PER BATCH"
        loadFavorites()
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function loadBatch()
        if not api.loading or api.ready or not api.enabled or not api.browserOpen then
            return 
        end
        local encoded = EmoteCatalogData.chunks[loadIndex]
        if not encoded then
            api.loading = false
            ;
            api.error = "Embedded catalog chunk missing"
            ;
            return 
        end
        local ok, rows = pcall(function()
            return http:JSONDecode(encoded)
        end)
        if not ok or type(rows) ~= "table" then
            api.loading = false
            ;
            api.error = "Catalog decoding failed; reopen or reload the full script"
            ;
            return 
        end
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
            if type(row) == "table" and type(row[1]) == "string" and row[1]:match("^%d+$") and not byId[row[1]] then
                local name = tostring(row[2] or ("Emote " .. row[1]))
                local item = {
                    id = row[1],
                    name = name,
                    key = name:lower(),
                }
                byId[item.id] = item
                ;
                items[#items + 1] = item
            end
        end
        EmoteCatalogData.chunks[loadIndex] = nil
        ;
        loadIndex = loadIndex + 1
        api.loaded = #items
        ;
        api.progress = "CATALOG " .. tostring(api.loaded) .. " / " .. tostring(api.total)
        if loadIndex > chunkCount then
            api.loading = false
            ;
            api.ready = true
            ;
            EmoteCatalogData.chunks = {
            }
            favoriteCount()
            ;
            startQuery()
            api.progress = tostring(api.loaded) .. " EMOTES READY / ONLY 12 CARDS RENDERED"
            if api.loaded ~= api.total then
                api.error = "Catalog count differs from embedded snapshot"
            end
        end
    end
    local function queryBatch()
        local job = queryJob
        if not job or not api.enabled or not api.browserOpen then
            return 
        end
        if job.generation ~= queryGeneration then
            queryJob = nil
            ;
            return 
        end
        local finish = math.min(
            #items,
            job.index + 1023
        )
        for i = job.index, finish do
            local item = items[i]
            local match = not job.favorites or favorites[item.id]
            if match then
                for _, word in ipairs(job.words) do
                    if not item.key:find(word, 1, true) then
                        match = false
                        ;
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if match then
                job.result[#job.result + 1] = item
            end
        end
        job.index = finish + 1
        ;
        api.filterProgress = math.floor(finish / math.max(1, #items) * 100)
        if job.index > #items then
            results = job.result
            ;
            queryJob = nil
            ;
            api.filtering = false
            ;
            api.filterProgress = 100
            ;
            api.page = 1
            ;
            updatePages()
        end
    end
    function api.closeBrowser()
        api.browserOpen = false
        ;
        api.stop(api.enabled and "R15 TOOL READY / TAP TO OPEN" or "R15 TOOL OFF")
        ;
        publish()
    end
    function api.open()
        if api.closed or not api.enabled then
            return false, "Turn R15 Tool ON first"
        end
        local _, hum = characterInfo()
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return false, "Waiting for a live character"
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return false, "R15 character required"
        end
        api.browserOpen = true
        ;
        stow()
        ;
        api.load()
        ;
        publish()
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function removeTool()
        disconnect(toolConnections)
        ;
        toolConnections = {
        }
        local current = tool
        ;
        tool = nil
        ;
        api.tool = nil
        ;
        drop(current)
    end
    local function ensureTool()
        if api.closed or not api.enabled then
            return 
        end
        local character, hum = characterInfo()
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            api.state = "TOOL ON / WAITING FOR CHARACTER"
            ;
            return 
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            removeTool()
            ;
            api.state = "R15 REQUIRED / TOOL NOT GRANTED TO R6"
            ;
            return 
        end
        if tool and tool.Parent then
            return 
        end
        removeTool()
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not backpack then
            api.state = "TOOL ON / WAITING FOR BACKPACK"
            ;
            return 
        end
        tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        ;
        tool.Name = "R15 Tool"
        ;
        tool.ToolTip = "Death'Note / R15 Emotes"
        tool.RequiresHandle = false
        ;
        tool.CanBeDropped = false
        ;
        tool.Enabled = true
        pcall(function()
            tool:SetAttribute(
                "DeathNoteEmoteTool",
                true
            )
        end)
        api.tool = tool
        connect(tool.Equipped, function()
            if api.enabled and not api.closed then
                api.open()
                local current = tool
                task.defer(function()
                    if tool == current and api.enabled and not api.closed then
                        stow()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end, toolConnections)
        connect(tool.Activated, function()
            if api.enabled and not api.closed then
                api.open()
            end
        end, toolConnections)
        tool.Parent = backpack
        ;
        api.state = "R15 TOOL READY / EQUIP OR TAP TO OPEN"
    end
    function api.setEnabled(value)
        if api.closed or type(value) ~= "boolean" then
            return false, "Use ON/OFF"
        end
        local _, hum = characterInfo()
        if value and hum and hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return false, "R15 character required; R6 was not changed"
        end
        api.enabled = value
        ;
        api.error = nil
        if value then
            ensureTool()
        else
            api.browserOpen = false
            ;
            api.stop("R15 TOOL OFF")
            ;
            removeTool()
        end
        publish(true)
        ;
        return true
    end
    local function validRequest(
        generation,
        character,
        hum
    )
        local current, currentHum = characterInfo()
        return not api.closed and api.enabled and generation == requestGeneration and current == character and currentHum == hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 and not moving(hum)
    end
    local function beginPlay(item)
        if nativeBusy then
            api.stop("WAITING FOR PREVIOUS EMOTE REQUEST")
            ;
            return false, "Previous native request is still finishing; tap again shortly"
        end
        local character, hum, animator = characterInfo()
        if not character or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return false, "Character unavailable"
        end
        if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            return false, "R15 character required"
        end
        if moving(hum) then
            return false, "Stop moving before starting an emote; walking/jumping cancels it"
        end
        if not animator then
            return false, "Waiting for the game's Animator"
        end
        if clock - lastClick < 0.25 then
            return false, "Wait briefly before selecting another emote"
        end
        lastClick = clock
        ;
        api.stop()
        ;
        api.error = nil
        local generation = requestGeneration
        stow()
        ;
        api.state = "LOADING EMOTE / " .. item.name
        ;
        inflight = {
            generation = generation,
            character = character,
            hum = hum,
            started = clock,
        }
        ;
        publish()
        task.spawn(function()
            if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                return 
            end
            local before = {
            }
            local snapshotOK = pcall(function()
                for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    before[track] = true
                end
            end)
            local function asTrack(value)
                local valid, isTrack = pcall(function()
                    return value:IsA("AnimationTrack")
                end)
                if valid and isTrack then
                    return value
                end
                return nil
            end
            local ok, track = false, nil
            if snapshotOK then
                local first, second
                nativeBusy = true
                ok, first, second = pcall(function()
                    return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(tonumber(item.id))
                end)
                nativeBusy = false
                if ok then
                    track = asTrack(first) or asTrack(second)
                end
            end
            local animation
            local direct = false
            if inflight and inflight.generation == generation then
                inflight = nil
            end
            if ok and track and before[track] then
                if generation == requestGeneration then
                    api.state = "NATIVE EMOTE ALREADY PLAYING / NOT TAKING OWNERSHIP"
                    ;
                    publish()
                end
                return 
            end
            if not ok or not track then
                if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                    return 
                end
                animation = Instance.new("Animation")
                ;
                animation.Name = "DeathNote_SelectedEmote"
                ;
                animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. item.id
                local loaded
                ok, loaded = pcall(function()
                    return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
                end)
                track = ok and asTrack(loaded) or nil
                direct = true
                if ok and track then
                    pcall(function()
                        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
                        ;
                        track.Looped = false
                    end)
                end
            end
            if not validRequest(generation, character, hum) then
                if track and not before[track] and track ~= ownedTrack and (not pending or pending.track ~= track) then
                    disposeTrack(
                        track,
                        animation
                    )
                else
                    drop(animation)
                end
                ;
                return 
            end
            if not ok or not track then
                drop(animation)
                ;
                api.state = "EMOTE UNAVAILABLE"
                ;
                api.error = "Asset rejected or not permitted in this experience"
                ;
                publish()
                ;
                return 
            end
            pending = {
                generation = generation,
                character = character,
                hum = hum,
                track = track,
                animation = animation,
                direct = direct,
                item = item,
                started = clock,
            }
        end)
        return true
    end
    function api.play(id)
        if api.closed or not api.enabled or not api.ready then
            return false, "Enable the Tool and wait for the catalog"
        end
        local item = byId[tostring(id)]
        if not item then
            return false, "Choose an emote from the embedded catalog"
        end
        return beginPlay(item)
    end
    function api.random()
        if not api.ready or #results == 0 then
            return false, "No loaded matching emotes"
        end
        return api.play(results[math.random(1, #results)].id)
    end
    local function playback()
        local character, hum = characterInfo()
        if inflight and (clock - inflight.started > 4 or character ~= inflight.character or hum ~= inflight.hum) then
            api.stop("EMOTE REQUEST CANCELLED / TIMEOUT OR CHARACTER CHANGE")
            ;
            return 
        end
        if ownedTrack and (character ~= ownedCharacter or hum ~= ownedHum or not hum or hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) then
            api.stop("EMOTE STOPPED / CHARACTER CHANGED")
            ;
            return 
        end
        if (ownedTrack or pending or inflight) and moving(hum) then
            api.stop("EMOTE STOPPED / MOVEMENT OR JUMP")
            ;
            return 
        end
        local job = pending
        if job then
            if not validRequest(job.generation, job.character, job.hum) then
                api.stop("EMOTE CANCELLED / CHARACTER CHANGED")
                ;
                return 
            end
            local ok, length = pcall(function()
                return job.track.Length
            end)
            if ok and type(length) == "number" and length > 0 then
                local played = true
                if job.direct and not job.playAttempted then
                    job.playAttempted = true
                    ;
                    played = pcall(function()
                        job.track:Play(
                            0.12,
                            1,
                            1
                        )
                    end)
                end
                if not played then
                    api.stop("EMOTE PLAY FAILED")
                    ;
                    api.error = "Animation playback was rejected"
                    ;
                    return 
                end
                local isPlaying = false
                ;
                pcall(function()
                    isPlaying = job.track.IsPlaying
                end)
                if isPlaying then
                    ownedTrack = job.track
                    ;
                    ownedAnimation = job.animation
                    ;
                    ownedCharacter = job.character
                    ;
                    ownedHum = job.hum
                    ;
                    pending = nil
                    api.nowPlaying = job.item.name
                    ;
                    api.nowId = job.item.id
                    ;
                    api.state = "PLAYING / " .. job.item.name
                elseif clock - job.started > 1 then
                    api.stop("EMOTE DID NOT START")
                    ;
                    api.error = "Native playback returned no active track"
                end
            elseif clock - job.started > 3 then
                api.stop("EMOTE ASSET NOT LOADED")
                ;
                api.error = "This asset is unavailable/restricted or did not load; normal animations were left running"
            end
        elseif ownedTrack then
            local ok, isPlaying = pcall(function()
                return ownedTrack.IsPlaying
            end)
            if not ok or not isPlaying then
                api.stop("EMOTE FINISHED / NATIVE PACK RESUMED")
            end
        end
    end
    function api.diagnostics()
        return {
            catalogCount = #items,
            resultCount = #results,
            pageSize = api.pageSize,
            tool = tool,
            ownedTrack = ownedTrack,
            pending = pending ~= nil,
            chunkIndex = loadIndex,
            chunkCount = chunkCount,
            filterJob = queryJob ~= nil,
            inflight = inflight ~= nil,
            nativeBusy = nativeBusy,
        }
    end
    function api.close()
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        api.closed = true
        ;
        api.enabled = false
        ;
        api.browserOpen = false
        api.stop("CLOSED")
        ;
        removeTool()
        ;
        saveFavorites()
        disconnect(connections)
        ;
        connections = {
        }
        ;
        listeners = {
        }
        ;
        queryJob = nil
        items = {
        }
        ;
        byId = {
        }
        ;
        results = {
        }
        ;
        favorites = {
        }
        ;
        EmoteCatalogData.chunks = {
        }
    end
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving, function(character)
        removing = character or LocalPlayer.Character
        ;
        api.browserOpen = false
        ;
        api.stop("WAITING FOR RESPAWN")
        ;
        removeTool()
        ;
        publish()
    end)
    connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        removing = nil
        ;
        api.stop(api.enabled and "R15 TOOL ON / RESPAWN" or "R15 TOOL OFF")
        ;
        if api.enabled then
            ensureTool()
        end
        ;
        publish()
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if not processed and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                if ownedTrack or pending or inflight then
                    api.stop("EMOTE STOPPED / MOVEMENT INPUT")
                end
            elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F6 and api.enabled then
                if api.browserOpen then
                    api.closeBrowser()
                else
                    api.open()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    connect(RunService.Heartbeat, function(dt)
        if api.closed then
            return 
        end
        local delta = math.clamp(
            tonumber(dt) or 0,
            0,
            1
        )
        ;
        clock = clock + delta
        ;
        maintenance = maintenance + delta
        playback()
        if maintenance >= 0.25 then
            maintenance = 0
            ;
            if api.enabled then
                ensureTool()
            end
        end
        loadBatch()
        if queryDue and clock >= queryDue then
            queryDue = nil
            ;
            startQuery()
        end
        queryBatch()
        if favoriteDirty and clock >= favoriteDue then
            saveFavorites()
        end
        publish()
    end)
    connect(MainGui.Destroying, function()
        api.close()
    end)
    return api
end)()

            "DeathNoteNowPlaying",
            "",

                1,
                -24,
                0,
                18
            ),

                0,
                12,
                1,

            ),

                1,

            ),

        ui.pageTotal = pageTotal
        on(top.InputBegan, function(inputEvent)
            if inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                drag = {
                    input = inputEvent,
                    start = inputEvent.Position,
                    position = root.Position,
                }
            end
        end, guiConnections)
        on(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(inputEvent)
            if not drag or not root then
                return 
            end
            if inputEvent == drag.input or drag.input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local delta = inputEvent.Position - drag.start
                ;
                local size = viewport()
                local x = drag.position.X.Scale * size.X + drag.position.X.Offset + delta.X
                local y = drag.position.Y.Scale * size.Y + drag.position.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                root.Position = UDim2.new(
                    0,
                    math.clamp(
                        x,
                        math.min(
                            root.Size.X.Offset / 2,
                            size.X / 2
                        ),
                        math.max(
                            size.X - root.Size.X.Offset / 2,
                            size.X / 2
                        )
                    ),
                    0,
                    math.clamp(
                        y,
                        math.min(
                            root.Size.Y.Offset / 2,
                            size.Y / 2
                        ),
                        math.max(
                            size.Y - root.Size.Y.Offset / 2,
                            size.Y / 2
                        )
                    )
                )
            end
        end, guiConnections)
        on(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(inputEvent)
            if drag and (inputEvent == drag.input or inputEvent.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                drag = nil
            end
        end, guiConnections)
        on(UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased, function()
            drag = nil
        end, guiConnections)
        local camera = game:GetService("Workspace").CurrentCamera
        if camera then
            on(
                camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"),
                resize,
                guiConnections
            )
        end
        resize()
    end
    local function refresh()
        if closing then
            return 
        end
        if panelRefresh then
            panelRefresh()
        end
        if not api.enabled then
            destroyGui()
            ;
            return 
        end
        if api.browserOpen then
            buildGui()
        end
        if not gui then
            return 
        end
        root.Visible = api.browserOpen
        ;
        gui.Enabled = api.browserOpen
        if not api.browserOpen then
            drag = nil
            ;
            return 
        end
        if api.ready then
            renderCards()
        end
        local _, count = api.pageItems()
        countLabel.Text = not api.ready and api.progress or api.filtering and ("SEARCHING " .. tostring(api.filterProgress) .. "% / PREVIOUS PAGE HELD WHILE FILTERING") or tostring(count) .. " MATCHES / " .. tostring(api.loaded) .. " CATALOG ENTRIES / PAGE " .. tostring(api.page) .. " OF " .. tostring(api.pages)

        local function updateLive()
            if not inspectorOpen then
                return 
            end
            local report = controller.slotReport()
            if not livePanel or #liveViews ~= #report then
                drawLive()

            for i, item in ipairs(controller.coverageReport()) do
                local value = liveCoverage[i]
                if value then
                    value.Text = item.available and (item.complete and "MATCHED" or tostring(item.slots) .. " SLOT(S)") or "MISSING"
                    value.TextColor3 = item.available and palette.green or palette.gold
                end
            end
            for i, item in ipairs(report) do
                local view = liveViews[i]
                if view then
                    view.title.Text = data.stateLabels[item.state] .. " / " .. item.name
                    view.value.Text = controller.normalize(item.id) or tostring(item.id)
                    view.ownership.Text = item.owned and "OWNED / RESTORE ON OFF" or "GAME VALUE / NOT FORCED"
                    view.ownership.TextColor3 = item.owned and palette.green or palette.muted
                end
            end
        end

        local function drawPack(

            pack,
            column
        )

                toast(controller.select(pack.name))
            end, rowConnections)

            ornament(

                pack.accent
            )
            local detail = button(card, "AnimationDetails_" .. pack.name, "VIEW IDS", UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 21), UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -29), palette.field, function()
                if selectedDetails == pack.name then
                    selectedDetails = nil
                else
                    selectedDetails = pack.name
                end
                if detailsPanel then
                    detailsPanel:Destroy()
                    ;
                    detailsPanel = nil
                end
                if selectedDetails then
                    for _, candidate in ipairs(data.packs) do
                        if candidate.name == selectedDetails then
                            detailsPanel = drawDetail(

                                parent.LayoutOrder + 1
                            )
                        end
                    end
                end
                for name, b in pairs(detailButtons) do
                    b.Text = name == selectedDetails and "HIDE IDS" or "VIEW IDS"
                end
            end, rowConnections)
            detailButtons[pack.name] = detail
            views[pack.name] = {
                rowOrder = parent.LayoutOrder,
                frame = card,
                toggle = toggle,
                border = border,
                meta = meta,
                accent = pack.accent,
            }
        end
        local function buildRows()
            if not alive then
                return 
            end
            clearRows()
            local query = search.Text:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
            local packs = {
            }
            for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
                if match(pack, query) then
                    packs[#packs + 1] = pack
                end
            end
            table.sort(packs, function(a, b)
                return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
            end)
            for i = 1, #packs, 2 do
                local row = frame(
                    scroll,
                    "AnimationPackRow" .. math.ceil(i / 2),
                    UDim2.new(
                        1,
                        -7,
                        0,
                        111
                    ),
                    UDim2.new(),
                    palette.background
                )
                row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                ;
                row.LayoutOrder = math.ceil(i / 2) * 2
                drawPack(
                    row,
                    packs[i],
                    0
                )
                if packs[i + 1] then
                    drawPack(
                        row,
                        packs[i + 1],
                        1
                    )
                end
            end
            if #packs == 0 then
                local empty = text(
                    scroll,
                    "AnimationNoResults",
                    "NO MATCHING PACKS / TRY ANOTHER NAME",
                    UDim2.new(
                        1,
                        -8,
                        0,
                        58
                    ),
                    UDim2.new(),
                    11,
                    palette.gold
                )
                empty.LayoutOrder = 1
                ;
                empty.TextWrapped = true
            end
            if selectedDetails then
                for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
                    if pack.name == selectedDetails and views[pack.name] then
                        detailsPanel = drawDetail(
                            pack,
                            views[pack.name].rowOrder + 1
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
            for name, b in pairs(detailButtons) do
                b.Text = name == selectedDetails and "HIDE IDS" or "VIEW IDS"
            end
            scroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(
                0,
                0
            )
            if inspectorOpen then
                drawLive()
            end
            if refresh then
                refresh()
            end
        end
        refresh = function()
            if not alive then
                return 
            end
            updateLive()
            local name = controller.current
            currentName.Text = name and name:upper() or controller.partialMatch and (controller.partialMatch:upper() .. " / PARTIAL") or controller.slots > 0 and "CUSTOM / MIXED OR GAME DEFAULT" or "WAITING FOR R15 ANIMATE"
            currentName.TextSize = name and 19 or 13
            rigBadge.Text = controller.rig == "R15" and "R15 READY" or controller.rig == "R6 / UNSUPPORTED" and "R6 BLOCKED" or "WAITING"
            rigBadge.TextColor3 = controller.rig == "R15" and palette.green or palette.gold
            selectedLabel.Text = "SELECTED: " .. (controller.selected and controller.selected:upper() or "NONE / ORIGINAL MODE") .. "  |  " .. tostring(controller.configured) .. "/" .. tostring(controller.slots) .. " SLOTS  |  " .. tostring(controller.coverage) .. "/8 STATES"
            playingLabel.Text = "PLAYING: " .. controller.playing
            stateLabel.Text = controller.lastError and ("ERROR: " .. controller.lastError) or controller.warning or controller.state
            stateLabel.TextColor3 = controller.lastError and palette.pink or controller.warning and palette.gold or palette.green
            footer.Text = controller.rig == "R6 / UNSUPPORTED" and "R15 PACKS REQUIRE AN R15 CHARACTER. NO FORCED RIG CONVERSION OR RESPAWN." or "SINGLE NATIVE ANIMATION OWNER / NO PARALLEL TRACK DRIVER / NATURAL STATE REFRESH / ASSET PERMISSIONS APPLY"
            local activeAccent = palette.cyan
            for _, pack in ipairs(data.packs) do
                if pack.name == name then
                    activeAccent = pack.accent
                    ;
                    break
                end
            end
            currentName.TextColor3 = name and activeAccent or palette.white
            stripe.BackgroundColor3 = activeAccent
            ;
            currentStroke.Color = activeAccent
            for packName, view in pairs(views) do
                local selected = controller.selected == packName
                local detected = controller.current == packName
                view.toggle.Text = selected and "ON" or "OFF"
                view.toggle.TextColor3 = selected and Color3.fromRGB(12, 29, 26) or palette.white
                view.toggle.BackgroundColor3 = selected and view.accent or palette.field
                view.border.Color = selected and view.accent or detected and Color3.fromRGB(
                    100,
                    125,
                    155) or Color3.fromRGB(60,
                    67,
                    94
                )
                view.border.Thickness = selected and 1.6 or 1
                view.meta.Text = selected and (detected and "CONFIGURED / NATIVE" or "SELECTED / SEE STATUS") or detected and "CURRENT GAME PACK" or "8 MOTION STATES"
                view.meta.TextColor3 = selected and view.accent or palette.white
            end
        end
        connect(
            search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),
            buildRows
        )
        connect(page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"), function()
            if page.Visible then
                controller.refresh()
                ;
                refresh()
            end
        end)
        connections[#connections + 1] = controller.subscribe(refresh)
        connect(MainGui.Destroying, function()
            if not alive then
                return 
            end
            alive = false
            for _, c in ipairs(rowConnections) do
                c:Disconnect()
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
                c:Disconnect()
            end
            rowConnections = {
            }
            ;
            connections = {
            }
            ;
            views = {
            }
            ;
            detailButtons = {
            }
        end)
        emoteTab = button(root, "R15EmotesTab", "R15 EMOTES", UDim2.new(0.32, -6, 0, 29), UDim2.new(0.38, 2, 0, 1), Color3.fromRGB(55, 19, 31), function()
            switchMode("Emotes")
        end)
        emoteTab.TextSize = 12
        emotesPanel = RedTelemetry.EmotesUI.mount(root)
        switchMode("Packs")
        buildRows()
        ;
        refresh()
    end)()
end

end)()
end

dockLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

local function AddDockBtn(shortCode, title, tabTarget)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Text = (title ~= "" and (shortCode .. " " .. title) or shortCode)
    b.Size = title == "ANIMATIONS" and UDim2.new(0, 116, 0, 26) or title ~= "" and UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 26) or UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 26)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = title ~= "" and RedTheme.Get("Accent") or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    b.BackgroundTransparency = title ~= "" and 0 or 1
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 10
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.LayoutOrder = title == "HOME" and 1 or title == "QUICK" and 2 or title == "VISUALS" and 3 or 4
    b.Parent = BottomDock
    if tabTarget then RedUI.DockButtons[tabTarget] = b end
    RedUI.Corner(b, 13)

    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        RedAudio.Play("Click")
        if tabTarget and TabBtns[tabTarget] then
            RedUI.SelectPage(tabTarget)
        else
            ShowToast("Feature", "Module ready for custom scripts", "Info")
        end
    end)
end

AddDockBtn("[H]", "HOME", "Dashboard")
AddDockBtn("[Q]", "QUICK", "Quick")
AddDockBtn("[V]", "VISUALS", "Visuals")
AddDockBtn("[A]", "ANIMATIONS", "Animations")

-- Local overhead tags and opt-in shared presence relay. The relay does not verify identities.
local presenceState = RedUI.Label(BrandHeaderBar, "PRESENCE: NOT CONFIGURED", UDim2.new(0, 125, 0, 18), UDim2.new(1, -245, 0.5, -9), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 8, Color3.fromRGB(175, 165, 185))
local tagMap = {}
local activePresence = {[LocalPlayer.UserId] = true}
local lastPresenceSuccess = 0
local requestFunction = (syn and syn.request) or http_request or request or (http and http.request)
local function removeTag(player)
    if tagMap[player] then tagMap[player]:Destroy(); tagMap[player] = nil end
end
local movementBusy = false
local function goToTaggedPlayer(player)
    if movementBusy or player == LocalPlayer then return end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local otherCharacter = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetRoot = otherCharacter and otherCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root or not targetRoot then ShowToast("Unavailable", "Player character not ready", "Info"); return end
    movementBusy = true
    local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
    flash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70)
    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
    flash.ZIndex = 50
    flash.Parent = MainGui
    RedAudio.Play("Notification")
    TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency=0.58}):Play()
    task.wait(0.2)
    if MainGui.Parent and root.Parent and targetRoot.Parent then
        local ok = pcall(function() root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(3,0,3) end)
        ShowToast(ok and "Moved" or "Move failed", ok and ("Near " .. player.Name) or "Movement blocked", "Info")
    end
    TweenService:Create(flash, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
    task.delay(0.4, function() if flash.Parent then flash:Destroy() end end)
    task.wait(0.6)
    movementBusy = false
end
local function syncTag(player)
    local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not activePresence[player.UserId] or not head then removeTag(player); return end
    if tagMap[player] and tagMap[player].Adornee == head then return end
    removeTag(player)
    local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    tag.Name = "DeathNotePresenceTag"
    tag.Adornee = head
    tag.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(195,48)
    tag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.8,0)
    tag.AlwaysOnTop = true
    tag.MaxDistance = 100
    tag.Parent = MainGui
    tagMap[player] = tag
    local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
    panel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16,13,18)
    panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
    panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    panel.Parent = tag
    RedUI.Corner(panel,12)
    RedUI.Stroke(panel,Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70),1.2)
    local icon = Instance.new("TextButton")
    icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34,34)
    icon.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7,7)
    icon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(9,9,11)
    icon.Text = "R"
    icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70)
    icon.TextSize = 25
    icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
    icon.Parent = panel
    RedUI.Corner(icon,8)
    RedUI.Stroke(icon,Color3.fromRGB(244,32,70),1)
    local name = RedUI.Label(panel, player.Name, UDim2.fromOffset(140,20), UDim2.fromOffset(49,5), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 12, Color3.fromRGB(245,243,247))
    name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    local role = string.lower(player.Name) == string.lower(OWNER_USERNAME) and "OWNER" or "USER"
    RedUI.Label(panel, role, UDim2.fromOffset(130,15), UDim2.fromOffset(49,25), Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 10, Color3.fromRGB(255,202,74))
    icon.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() goToTaggedPlayer(player) end)
end
local function syncAllTags()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do syncTag(player) end
    for player in pairs(tagMap) do if player.Parent ~= Players then removeTag(player) end end
end
local function updateSharedPresence()
    if os.clock() - lastPresenceSuccess > 50 then activePresence = {[LocalPlayer.UserId] = true} end
    if not SHARE_PRESENCE then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: OFF"; return end
    if PRESENCE_URL == "" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: SET BACKEND URL"; return end
    if not PRESENCE_URL:match("^https://") then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: HTTPS REQUIRED"; return end
    if type(requestFunction) ~= "function" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: HTTP UNAVAILABLE"; return end
    if game.JobId == "" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: NO SERVER ID"; return end
    local ok, response = pcall(requestFunction, {Url=PRESENCE_URL, Method="POST", Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"}, Body=HttpService:JSONEncode({userId=LocalPlayer.UserId, placeId=game.PlaceId, jobId=game.JobId})})
    if not MainGui.Parent then return end
    local status = ok and response and tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.Status)
    if not status or status < 200 or status >= 300 then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: CONNECTION FAILED"; return end
    local valid, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body) end)
    if not valid or type(data)~="table" or type(data.userIds)~="table" then presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: BAD RESPONSE"; return end
    lastPresenceSuccess = os.clock()
    activePresence = {[LocalPlayer.UserId] = true}
    for _, id in ipairs(data.userIds) do if type(id)=="number" then activePresence[id]=true end end
    presenceState.Text="PRESENCE: ONLINE (UNVERIFIED)"
end
task.spawn(function()
    while MainGui and MainGui.Parent do
        updateSharedPresence()
        syncAllTags()
        for _=1,15 do if not MainGui.Parent then return end; task.wait(1) end
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    while MainGui and MainGui.Parent do syncAllTags(); task.wait(2) end
end)

-- Global Keybind
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then toggleWindow() end
end)

-- ============================================================================
-- CORE ENGINE EXTENSION NODE 1: ADVANCED UTILITY SUBSYSTEM
-- Provides high-frequency event caching, reactive subscriptions, and math helpers.
-- ============================================================================
local DeathNoteSubsystem_1 = {}
do
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.NodeId = 1
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Active = true
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache = {}
    DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers = {}

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Register(key, value)
        DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache[key] = value
        local hList = DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key]
        if hList then
            for idx = 1, #hList do
                pcall(hList[idx], value)
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Get(key, fallback)
        local val = DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache[key]
        if val == nil then return fallback end
        return val
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Bind(key, fn)
        if not DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key] then
            DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key] = {}
        end
        table.insert(DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers[key], fn)
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Purge()
        table.clear(DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Cache)
        table.clear(DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Handlers)
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_1.CheckIntegrity()
        local k = "NodeTest_" .. tostring(1)
        DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Register(k, os.time())
        return DeathNoteSubsystem_1.Get(k) ~= nil
    end
end

-- CORE ENGINE EXTENSION NODE 14: ADVANCED UTILITY SUBSYSTEM
-- Provides high-frequency event caching, reactive subscriptions, and math helpers.
-- ============================================================================
local DeathNoteSubsystem_14 = {}
do
    DeathNoteSubsystem_14.NodeId = 14
    DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Active = true
    DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Cache = {}
    DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Handlers = {}

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Register(key, value)
        DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Cache[key] = value
        local hList = DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Handlers[key]
        if hList then
            for idx = 1, #hList do
                pcall(hList[idx], value)
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Get(key, fallback)
        local val = DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Cache[key]
        if val == nil then return fallback end
        return val
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Bind(key, fn)
        if not DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Handlers[key] then
            DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Handlers[key] = {}
        end
        table.insert(DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Handlers[key], fn)
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Purge()
        table.clear(DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Cache)
        table.clear(DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Handlers)
    end

    function DeathNoteSubsystem_14.CheckIntegrity()
        local k = "NodeTest_" .. tostring(14)
        DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Register(k, os.time())
        return DeathNoteSubsystem_14.Get(k) ~= nil
    end
end

-- The GUI is already visible. Photo/game/creation metadata load independently.
RedTelemetry.AgeService.start()
RedTelemetry.AvatarService.startOwn()
task.spawn(function()
    if RedTelemetry.Closed then return end
    RedTelemetry.AgeService.refreshLocal(true)
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local function valid() return not RedTelemetry.Closed end
    if not valid() then return end
    local ok,image,ready=RedTelemetry.AvatarService.bounded(10,function()
        return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(LocalPlayer.UserId,Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size352x352)
    end,valid)
    if ok and ready~=false and type(image)=="string" and image~="" and valid() then
        RedTelemetry.PlayerThumbnail=image
    end
end)
task.spawn(function()
    local function valid() return not RedTelemetry.Closed end
    if not valid() then return end
    local ok,info=RedTelemetry.AvatarService.bounded(10,function()
        return MarketplaceService:GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId)
    end,valid)
    if not ok or type(info)~="table" or not valid() then return end
    if type(info.Name)=="string" and info.Name~="" then RedTelemetry.GameTitle=info.Name end
    if tonumber(info.IconImageAssetId) and tonumber(info.IconImageAssetId)>0 then
        RedTelemetry.GameThumbnail="rbxassetid://"..tostring(info.IconImageAssetId)
    elseif tonumber(game.GameId) and game.GameId>0 then
        RedTelemetry.GameThumbnail="rbxthumb://type=GameIcon&id="..tostring(game.GameId).."&w=150&h=150"
    end
end)
return MainGui
